tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa dgongs pa gsal ba'i nyi 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ sa lam gyi rnam gzhag dgongs pa gsal ba'i nyi 'od ces bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ldan gtsug gi chu shel mdangs phrog mtshan dpe'i ri dwags dang ldan zhing / /ral pa'i khur byung lam gsum chu bo'i bsil las ches lhag drug cu'i dbyangs/ /gsum brtsegs bsreg byed drag po'i mig las nus pa'i mthu ldan mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /gang la reg ldan bla ma mchog dang lha'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis mkhas la dang blo'i nus pa ster byed cing / /bar ma rnams la'ang legs bshad mig dang ldan gyur pa/ /rmongs pa rnams kyi blo'i mun pa sel ba'i mchog /sa lam rnam gzhag dgongs gsal nyi 'od bdag gis bri/ /'di la gsum te/ spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa/ skabs su bab pa sa lam nyid bshad pa/ des grub pa'i 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la spyir gang zag ni rigs gsum ste srid pa 'dod pa dang / de dang bral bar 'dod pa dang / de gnyis ka mi 'dod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyang 'phen pa dang / lta ba chad pa'i mtha' smra ba la sogs te/ de dag ni khams gsum sa dgu la ngan 'gro'i lam dang / bde 'gro'i lam gnyis las/ lta ba ngan pa'i 'bras bu ni ngan 'gro nyid du nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni mu stegs mchog gcer bu ba dang / rang sde grub mtha' 'og ma la gnas pa rnams te/ de dag ni srid pa zad pa'i thabs/ tshul khrims la 'bad kyang lta ba ma dag pas bde 'gro nyid thob kyi nges legs thob pa ni ma yin/ yang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang thabs la mkhas pa khyad par can dang bral bas srid pa dang bral bar 'dod pa yin gyi srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa theg pa chen po ni/ lta ba bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis srid pa mi 'dod pa dang / spyod pa thabs mkhas khyad par can byang chub kyi sems brtse ba snying rje chen po la sogs pas mya ngan las 'das pa la yang gnas pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/

rgyan las/ tshul rol pha rol mtha' la min zhes dang / nyir snang las byang chub sems dpa'i snying brtse ni/ srid pa dga' bar byed pa ste/ /blo yi de ni gnas pa yang / /brkam pa rjes su sems ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar gang zag ni rigs gsum las/ dang po ni chos la dngos su 'jug pa ma yin la/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni chos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang po dad pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas mngon mtho dang / de'i steng du yang dag pa'i lta ba la brten nas nges legs byang chub gsum (gnyis )dang / de'i steng du/ thabs mkhas khyad par can la brten nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ dad can nyid phyir chos la brten/ /shes rab ldan phyir yang dag rig /'di gnyis gtso bo shes rab ste/ /de yi sngon 'gro dad pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / sbyin dang tshul khrims gzhan gyi don/ /bzod pa brtson 'grus 'di nyid kyi/ /rten nam shes rab thar pa'i rgyu/ /theg chen don ni bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i sa lam nyid bshad pa la/ gang la skye ba'i rten/ de la brten nas skyes pa'i sa lam gyi rnam gzhag dngos bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la lus rten dang / sems rten gnyis/ dang po ni rang stobs kyis sngar med pa'i gsar du ngan song gsum dang sgra mi snyan pa la mi skye ste/ rnam smin gyi sgrib pa shas chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ za ma dang ma ning la yang mi skye ste/ gnyen po so sor rtog pa'i shes rab spyad mi bzod pa'i phyir/ las kyi sgrib pa shas chen po dang ldan pas mtshams med lnga byas pa la yang mi skye la/ khams gong ma la dngos su mi skye ste/ rgyud ting nge 'dzin gyi g.yengs pas sems long med pa'i phyir/ skyes zin gnas pa ni de dag thams cad la shes par bya'o/ /gzhan stobs kyis de dag thams cad la yang skye ste/ 'khor mo 'jig gi yul du/

'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis yi dwags mang po bden pa mthong ba la bkod par bshad pa'i phyir dang / pad dkar las klu nyi khri chig stong gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir dang / sher phyin gyi mdo las kyang gzugs na spyod pa dang / gzugs med na spyod pa'i lha'i bu mang po byang chub tu sems bskyed par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sems rten la/ mthong lam yan chad ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer sdogs/ dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po dang / khyad par can gnyis/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi ste bsam gtan sa drug dang / gzugs med dang po gsum ste/ zag med sa dgu po gang rung la brten dgos te/ spang bya mthong spang spong ba la/ zhi gnas khyad par can sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu mthar phyin pa dang / lhag mthong khyad par can bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab zung du 'jug dgos pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de nas ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshogs sbyor ni thog mar 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi rten kho na la skye yang bsam pa 'dod pas bsdus pa las ni nges par tshogs lam skye dgos la/ sbyor lam ni 'dod pa dang / gzugs kyi sas bsdus gnyis la skye ba yod pa shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de la brten nas skyes pa'i sa lam gyi rnam gzhag dngos la/ sa yi rnam gzhag dang / lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la sa'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i nges legs kyi lam gyis bsdus pa'i rtogs pa sa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ nyan thos rang rgyal gyi sa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ sangs rgyas kyi sa dang bzhi/ dang po la yang mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i nyan thos kyi rtogs pa de/

nyan thos kyi sa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na/ dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa/ rigs kyi sa/ brgyad pa'i sa/ mthong ba'i sa/ srab pa'i sa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa/ nyan thos kyi sa dang brgyad de/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ ji ltar nyan thos theg pa las/ /nyan thos sa ni brgyad bshad pa/ /de bzhin theg pa chen po la'ang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu bstan/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /brgyad kyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ bsam pa'i stobs kyis gnas skabs nyan thos su rigs nges pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de/ dang po'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnas skabs nyan thos su rigs nges pa'i nyan thos sbyor lam pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de lnga pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de drug pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de bdun pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa/ nyan thos dgra bcom zhugs pa gsum po gang rung gi yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de brgyad pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ 'o na nyan thos la sa brgyad kyis zlas phye ba'i nyan thos kyi sa de/ nges par 'bras gnas gsum po gang rung gi rtogs par nges sam zhe na/ de ni ma nges te/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang / de'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pas ma nges pa'i phyir/ des na nyan thos kyi sa de la/ de gnyis dang / rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can dang /

phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can dang / phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can dang gsum gyi rtogs pa ni rim bzhin phyir 'ong zhugs pa/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa/ dgra bcom zhugs pa gsum gyi rtogs pa yin pas/ rim gyis pa'i zhugs pa'i rgyud kyi rtogs pa dang / cig car ba'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can gyi rtogs pa ni/ cig car ba'i dgra bcom zhugs pa'i rtogs pa yin pas/ cig car ba'i rtogs pa ste/ mdor na chags bral sngon song dang / rim gyis pa/ cig car ba gsum ga'i rtogs pa yod par shes par bya'o/ /gang dag nyan thos zhugs pa'am/ zhugs pa (zhugs pa kho na )yin na/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa yin pas khyab par smra ba rnams la ni/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang / de'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa gnyis ni/ /zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas gang rung yin par thal/ rim bzhin phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang / phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ zhugs pa yin par thal/ zhugs gnas gang rung gang zhig 'bras gnas ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa yin par thal/ zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma ma grub na/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob par thal/ zhugs gnas gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i 'bras gnas yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'di lta bu'i ma dpyad pa'i grub mtha' la 'jug par mi bya ste/ rtsib ma chag pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la yang mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa/ gnyis pa la/ bse ru lta bu'i sa dang / tshogs spyod kyi sa gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa dang / tshogs na spyod pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa la/ spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa dang gnyis las/

dang po la/ sa yi mtshan nyid/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ 'grub pa'i dus kyi khyad par dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang / /stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab zung du chud pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi byang sems 'phags pa'i yon tan gyi rten dang / rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i sras phyi ma skyed pa'i rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ 'o na mos pas spyod pa'i sas ma nges so zhe na/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ dper na mos pas spyod pa'i sa de nyan thos kyi sa dang po yin par thal/ theg chen gyi mthong lam de byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab sgrigs mtshams dang bcas pa khas/ 'dod na/ brgyad pa'i sa de nyan thos kyi sa gsum pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ min par thal/ sa brgyad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i sa de la bcu gcig tu yod par thal/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa de byang chub sems dpa'i sa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mos pas spyod pa'i sa de dang po yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sa bcu pa de byang chub sems dpa'i sa min par thal/ de 'bras bu'i sa yin gyi/ rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i sa min pa'i phyir zhes zer na/ 'o na/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa de nyan thos kyi sa min par thal/ de saṃ zhugs pa phyi ma gsum po gang rung gi rtogs pa min pa'i phyir/ ma khyab ste/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa de/ sa brgyad kyis zlas phye ba'i nyan thos kyi sa min cing / theg pa gsum gyis zlas phye ba'i nyan thos kyi sa yin pa'i phyir zhes zer na/ 'o na/ gong ma la yang ma khyab ste/ sa bcu pa de rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang / 'bras bu'i sa gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa min cing / byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcus zlas phye ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa yin pa'i phyir/

rin chen 'phreng ba las/ de bzhin theg pa chen po la'ang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa yon tan gyi khyad par la/ bslab pa gsum sbyong ba'i khyad par/ zag med kyi phung po lnga sbyong ba'i khyad par/ phar phyin lhag pa'i khyad par/ mnyam gzhag tu chos nyid rtogs pa'i khyad par/ rjes thob tu nges shes 'dren pa'i khyad par/ rnam smin gyi skye ba 'dzin tshul gyi khyad par/ yongs sbyong gi chos kyi khyad par dang bdun las/ dang po ni/ sa dang por bslab pa gsum gyi rten byed pa dang / gnyis pa la tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor sbyong / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa dang gsum la ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gtso bor sbyong / drug pa nas bcu pa'i bar la shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa dang po la phung po lnga char gyi rten byed pa dang / gnyis pa la tshul khrims kyi phung po sbyong / gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa gsum la ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po sbyong / drug pa dang bdun pa gnyis la shes rab kyi phung po sbyong / brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar la rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po sbyong ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dbus mtha' las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan dang ni shes rab thabs/ /smon lam stobs dang ye shes te/ /'di rnams pha rol phyin bcur 'dod/ khyad par can dang khyad med ni/ /sa bcu dag la rim shes bya/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ sa bcu la rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mthong ba la khyad par med de/ chos nyid cha shes med pa la mthong ma mthong gi cha gnyis med pa'i phyir/ glo bur dri bral gyi chos nyid mthong ba la ni khyad par yod de/ sa re re la glo bur dri dral gyi chos nyid gsar mthong re re yod pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ sprin mthong mkha' la nyi bzhin 'dir khyod phyogs gcig blo gros can/

/blo mig dag pa'i 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mthong ma lags/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod chos sku mtha' yas gang dag rab zhi ba/ shes bya mtha' med mkha' dbyings khyab pa de dag gis kun mthong / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ dbus mtha' las/ kun tu 'gro don mchog gi don/ /rgyu mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang / /yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang / /rgyud rnams tha dad med don dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /drug pa ni sa dang po la 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal po/ gnyis pa la gling bzhi'i rgyal po/ gsum pa la brgya sbyin/ bzhi pa la 'thab bral gyi rgyal po/ lnga pa la dga' ldan gyi rgyal po/ drug pa la 'phrul dga'i rgyal po/ bdun pa la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi rgyal po/ brgyad pa la stong gi bdag po tshangs pa/ dgu pa la stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs chen/ bcu pa la 'og min gyi rgyal po lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po rnams su skye ba 'dzin par sa bcu pa dang / rin chen 'phreng bar bshad do/ /bdun pa ni/ dang bcu gnyis brgyad gsum pa lnga/ /bzhi bcu lnga bcu drug cu gnyis/ /bdun pa nyi shu brgyad pa brgyad/ /dgu pa la ni bcu gnyis te/ /kun sdom dgu bcu go lnga'o/ /gsum pa 'grub pa'i dus kyi khyad par la/ gang zag dbang po rnon pos ni/ mos spyod la bskal pa grangs med gcig ma dag sa bdun la grangs med gcig dag pa sa gsum la grangs med gcig ste/ bskal pa grangs med gsum dgos so/ /mdzod las/ de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ zhes dang / rigs gter las/ grangs med gsum gyis de mthar phyin/ /zhes dang / sdom gsum las/ /de yis ji ltar myur na yang / /grangs med gsum gyis dka' spyod dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /dbang po 'bring pos ni/ mos spyod la bskal pa grangs med drug sa bcu po re re la bskal pa grangs med gsum gsum ste/ sum cu rtsa drug dgos par dbyig gnyen gyis mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang /

slob dpon gyis 'grel chen las bshad do/ /dbang po rtul po la ni bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang grangs med pa dgos par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa la/ sa bcu po re re la yang / mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba dang / skye ba'i tshul dang / sgra bshad pa dang bzhi bzhir shes par bya ba la/ sa dang po'i mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor sbyin pa'i phar phyin la spyod pa'i sgo nas byang sems mthong lam pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ mnyam gzhag ye shes dang / rjes thob ye shes gnyis/ dang po la dbye na/ chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes dang / kun rdzob la mnyam par gzhag pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes gnyis/ de'i dang po la yang / sdug bsngal chos bzod lta bu bar chad med lam/ chos shes lta bu rnam grol lam/ rjes shes lta bu khyad par gyi lam dang gsum/ gnyis pa la yang mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam 'gyings dang / zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / zil gnon gyi dang / mthar gnas kyi dang / rnam thar gyi dang lnga yod kyi/ sa dang po na thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin med par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rjes thob la dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mos/ bsngo/ rjes su yi rang dang gsum/ yongs sbyong gi sgo nas bcu/ ston tshul gyi sgo nas yongs sbyongs dang / rjes thob/ rten 'brel la rtog pa gnyis rnams su yod do/ /gsum pa skye ba'i tshul ni/ dang por mnyam gzhag ye shes skye ste/ sdug bsngal chos bzod de/ sa dang po'i skad cig ma dang po yin pa'i phyir/ mjug ni rjes thob kyis 'dzin te/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyongs rdzogs ma thag pa de/ sa gnyis pa'i ye shes yin pa gang zhig sa dang po'i yongs sbyongs rnams kyang rjes thob ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ rgyan las/ byang chub la ni nye ba dang / /sems can don sgrub mthong ba la/ /rab tu dga' ba skye 'gyur te/

/de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sa gnyis pa la yang bzhi las/ gtso bor tshul khrims kyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas byang sems sgom lam pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de sa gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na sngar ltar gnyis/ de'i dang po la yang sngar ltar spong ba'i lam/ rnam grol lam/ khyad par gyi lam dang gsum mo/ gnyis pa la sbyor ba seng ge rnam 'gyings dang / thod rgal/ mthar gnas/ rnam thar/ zad par/ zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin dang drug yod cing / mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam 'gyings ni/ sa gnyis pa yan la med par shes par bya dgos so/ /gal te kho na re/ sa gnyis pa'i sbyor ba seng ge rnam 'gyings chos can/ mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam 'gyings yin par thal/ mnyam gzhag dang seng ge rnam 'gyings kyi gzhi mthun pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ 'o na sa dang po'i mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam 'gyings chos can/ sbyor ba seng ge'i rnam 'gyings yin par thal/ sbyor ba dang seng ge rnam 'gyings kyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir ro/ /byas pa la khyod ci zer/ des na ding sang / sa lam skye tshul gyi rim pa mi shes par/ sa gnyis pa'i sbyor ba seng ge rnam 'gyings de/ sa dang po'i ye shes yin par khas blangs nas/ sa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba yin no zhes zer ba dang / yang la la/ sa gnyis pa'i dang por sbyor ba'i lam/ de nas bar chad med lam/ de nas rnam grol lam/ de nas seng ge rnam 'gyings/ thod rgal/ de nas rjes thob ye shes skye ba yin no zhes zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig nges pa med par/ sa gnyis pa'i gang zag la la ni/ rjes thob dang por skye ba yang yod cing / kha cig la mnyam gzhag dang por skye ba yang yod pa yin no zhes zer ba sogs/ ding sang gi phar phyin pa rnams mkhas pa chen po'i nga rgyal rang sa nas smra yang / gtad thub pa'i grub mtha' med par nges med sna tshogs smra bar byed pa yin no/

/kho bo ni/ gzhung 'grel gyi dgongs pa/ bla ma'i man ngag gi sgo nas smra bar byed de shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa rjes thob la/ ngo bo'i sgo nas sngar ltar gsum/ yongs sbyong gi sgo nas brgyad/ ston tshul gyi sgo nas yongs sbyong rgyun chags pa'i sgo/ sems 'jal rtog gsum byed pa/ mos/ bsngo/ rjes su yi rang dang lngar yod do/ /gsum pa skye tshul ni/ sa gnyis pa'i dang por rjes thob skye ba yin te/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong rdzogs ma thag pa de/ sa gnyis pa'i ye shes yin pa ni gang zhig sa dang po'i yongs sbyong thams cad rjes thob yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste 'grel chen las/ ji srid sa de yongs su sbyong ba ma shes pa de srid du ni sa de yin la rdzogs nas ni sa gzhan yin no zhes dang / ka shi'i sgom rim bar ma las kyang / 'di kho na bzhin gsungs pa'i phyir dang / yongs sbyong gi don yang / sa rang gi skyon sbyong ba dang / gong ma'i yon tan thob pa'i phyir brtson pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gtan tshigs gnyis pa ni mthun grub du yod pas sgrub mi dgos so/ /des na sa gnyis pa la ni dang por rjes thob skye/ de na sbyor ba seng ge rnam 'gyings dang / de nas thod rgal/ de nas bar chad med lam/ de nas rnam grol lam/ de nas khyad par lam/ de nas yongs sbyong byed pa yang yod la/ yang dang por rjes thob/ de nas bar chad med lam/ rnam grol lam/ khyad par lam/ de nas sbyor ba seng ge rnam 'gyings dang / dngos gzhi thod rgal dang / zad par dang / zil gnon la sogs pa dang / de nas yongs sbyong byed pa yang yod pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /sa gnyis pa nas bzung ste dgu pa'i bar sa brgyad kyi skye tshul ni 'di kho na yin par rig par bya'o/ /sa gnyis pa'i mjug kyang rjes thob kyis 'dzin te/ sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong thams cad rjes thob yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ 'chal tshul rtsol ba'i dri bral phyir/

/dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /sa gsum pa la yang sngar ltar bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor bzod pa'i phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas byang sems sgom lam pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ yongs sbyong gi grangs ma gtogs pa snga ma ji lta ba bzhin dang / gsum pa skye tshul yang snga ma ji lta ba bzhin no/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ chos kyi snang ba chen po ni/ /byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /sa bzhi pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas sogs sngar ltar du bsgre'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba dang / gsum pa skye tshul yang sngar ltar ro/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ 'di ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos/ /rab tu sreg byed 'od lta bu/ /de dang ldan phyir sa de ni/ /gnyis po sregs pa 'od 'phro can/ /zhes so/ /sa lnga pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor bsam gtan gyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas sogs bsgre'o/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa yang sngar ltar ro/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ sems can rnams yongs smin byed dang / /rang gi sems kyang bsrung ba'i phyir/ /blo ldan rnams kyi sbyang dka' ba/ /de phyir sbyang dka' zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sa drug pa la yang bzhi las/ gtso bor shes rab kyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas sogs bsgre'o/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa 'dra/ bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ /gnyis 'dir mngon du gyur ba'i phyir/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sa bdun pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor thabs kyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas sogs bsgre'o/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa yang 'dra/ bzhi pa ni/ bgrod cig lam dang 'brel ba'i phyir/ /ring du song ba'i sar 'dod do/

/zhes gsungs so/ /sa brgyad pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor smon lam gyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas sogs bsgre'o/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa yang 'dra/ bzhi pa ni/ 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo'i phyir/ /mi g.yo ba zhes nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ /sa dgu pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor stobs kyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas sogs bsgre'o/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa 'dra/ bzhi pa ni/ so so yang dag rig blo bzang / /sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sa bcu pa la bzhi las/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor ye shes kyi phar phyin la longs spyod pa'i sgo nas theg chen sgom lam pa'i yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i rtogs pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba lngar ltar gnyis las/ de'i dang po la/ spong ba'i lam dang / khyad par gyi lam gnyis yod kyi/ rnam grol gyi lam ni med de/ sa bcu pa'i bar chad med lam yin na/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes yin dgos pa ni gang zhig bar chad med lam sngon du ma song ba'i rnam grol lam med pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sgom spang shes sgrib chung ngu'i chung ngu'i dngos gnyen 'juṃg paṃ bar chad med lam yin na rgyun mtha'i ye shes yin dgos pa'i phyir dang / nyi snang dang / 'grel chen dang / 'grel chung la sogs pa rnams las kyang / byang sems kyis spang bya spong tshul/ cig car ba kho na bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjes thob la/ dbye na ngo bo'i sgo nas/ mos bsngo/ rjes su yi rang dang gsum/ ston tshul ni/ 'bras bu'i sa'i/ ldog pa nas ston gyi sngar gyi yongs sbyongs kyi sgo nas bstan pa ni med de/ sa bcu pa la yongs sbyongs med pa'i phyir/ yod na sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyongs rdzogs ma thag pa de sangs rgyas kyi sar khas len dgos pa dang / de ltar na rgyun mtha'i ye shes de sa bcu pa'i ye shes skad cig ma tha ma ma yin pa'am/

yang na yongs sbyongs su khas len dgos pa las/ dang po mi rung ste/ skad cig ma tha ma'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mi rung ste rjes thob min pa'i phyir ro/ /gang dag sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyongs nyid/ sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyongs su 'dod pa rnams kyis skye tshul gyi gnad ma rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa skye tshul ni/ sa bcu pa'i dang por rjes thob skye ste/ sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyongs rdzogs ma thag pa de sa bcu pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug ni mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin de/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes de/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes skad cig ma tha ma yin pa gang zhig de mnyam gzhag yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ sprin bzhin gnyis kyis nam mkha'i chos/ /khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang sa bcu la gang zag rnam par dag pa dang / yon tan gyi grangs brtsi tshul/ spang bya spong tshul la sogs pa ni/ sa bcu pa dang / 'jug pa dang / mdo sde rgyan dang / byang sa dang / rin chen 'phreng ba dang / chos dbyings bstod pa dang / dbus mtha' sogs las rgyas par blo gros kyi rgya bskyed de/ bslab nas mkhas par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba/ skye tshul/ sgra bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni spangs pa dang / ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i rten byed pa'i rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ shes bya mkhyen tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis so/ /gnas gyur gyi sgo nas dbye na me long lta bu'i/ mnyam pa nyid kyi/ so sor rtog pa'i/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ kun gzhi gnas gyur pa la brten nas shes bya thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar mkhyen pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ nyon yid gnas gyur pa la brten nas 'khor 'das thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/ (yid shes gnas gyur pa la brten nas chos can thams cad so sor rtog pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes/)

sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa la brten nas gdul bya'i bya ba sna tshogs sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes te/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin yin la/ de la me long lta bu'i ye shes ni/ rten gyi ye shes sam/ mi g.yo ba'i ye shes yin la/ lhag ma gsum ni brten pa'i ye shes sam/ g.yo ba'i ye shes yin te/ rgyu'i dus su kun gzhi thams cad kyi rten dang / 'jug shes drug dang / nyon yid ni de la brten nas g.yo ba yin pa'i phyir/ rgyan las kyang / me long ye shes mi g.yo te/ ye shes gsum ni de la brten/ mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na ye shes bzhi po de/ rang ldog nas g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba'i ye shes su khas len par bya'i/ khyab mtha' ni mi mcha' ste/ ye shes bzhi po mi 'gal zhing / g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba ni 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa las mdor bsdu na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ni lngar rig par bya ste/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / de bzhin du mnyam pa nyid dang / bya ba grub pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnams ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don du bsams nas 'ga' zhig chos dbyings ye shes dang lnga yin no zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la ye shes bzhi las mi 'dod par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bsod nams rtse mos gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa las/ chos dbyings ye shes kyi tha snyad ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na de'i skabs kyi chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag sangs rgyas kyi sa yin par bshad na/ sa de ci zhe na/ de ni rgyu'i dus kyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi gsal cha gnas gyur pa las/ me long ye shes dang / stong pa'i cha gnas gyur pa las chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/

zhib par ni ngag las rtogs par bya'o/ /gsum pa skye ba'i tshul ni/ mnyam rjes dbyer med yin pas gang 'dod kyi sgo nas bshad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ mdo las/ ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang / /shes bya la yang blo rgyas phyir/ /sangs rgyas padma ltar sangs rgyas/ /de phyir sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar yin no/ sa'i sgra don ni/ rgyan las/ 'byung po dpag med 'jig med phyir/ /dpag tu med pa de dag la/ /phyi phyir gong du 'gro ldan phyir/ /de dag nyid la sar 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ lam gyi mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs sam/ byang chub kyi go skabs phyi shul du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ nyan thos kyi lam/ rang rgyal gyi lam/ theg chen gyi lam dang gsum/ dang po la yang / mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs sam/ nyan thos kyi byang chub kyi go skabs phyi shul gyur pa'o/ /dbye na nyan thos kyi tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam dang lnga las/ dang po la'ang mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la kha cig nyan thos las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs yin zer na/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam rgyud ldan gyi nyan thos las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs rnams/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ des na rang lugs ni/ nyan thos las dang po pa'i rgyud kyi nyan thos kyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chung ngu / 'bring / chen po dang gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i yon tan gyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de la dran pa nye bzhag bzhi ni/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ tshor ba/ sems/ chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang bzhi'o/ /snga ma de gang zhig yang dag spong ba bzhi'i yon tan gyis rab tu phye ba'o/

/de bzhi ni mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa/ skyes pa spong ba/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa/ skyes pa spel ba'i yang dag spong ba dang bzhir yod/ de gang zhig rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i yon tan gyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de bzhi ni/ 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems kyi dang / brtson 'grus kyi dang / dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang bzhi'o/ /yang gsum po de re re la yang / dbang po rnon po shes rab lhag pas lam gyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / dbang po rtul po dad pa lhag pas lam gyi rjes su 'brang ba gnyis/ yang gnas skabs nyan thos kyi rigs nges pa nges pa'i rigs can dang / theg pa gzhan du 'gyur srid pa/ ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi tshogs lam gnyis rnams su yang yod/ gnyis pa nyan thos kyi sbyor lam la yang mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ yon tan/ sgra bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ nyan thos sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi byang chub kyi go skabs phyi shul gyur pa de'o/ /gnyis pa la ngo bo'i sgo nas/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam drod rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chen po'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / rtse mo skad cig ma dang po ma skyes gong gi nyan thos kyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs so/ /de'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing bzod pa dang po ma skyes gong gi 'dra/ de'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / chos mchog dang po ma skyes gong gi 'dra/ de'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing sdug bsngal chos bzod ma skyes gong gi 'dra/ /drod sogs bzhi po re re la yang chung ngu 'bring chen po dang gsum gsum du yod la bye brag du smra ba ni/ chos mchog skad cig ma gcig kho nar 'dod pas dbye ba mi bzhed de/ mdzod las/ ji ltar bzod chen skad cig ma/

/gcig yin de bzhin chos mchog kyang / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang de re re la yang gnas skabs nyan thos kyi byang chub tu rigs nges pa dang / ma nges pa gnyis gnyis su yod la/ bye brag tu smra ba ni bzod chen thob nas rigs nges par 'dod de/ mdzod las/ gnyis slob rigs las zlog nas ni/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang rten gyi gang zag gis dbye na/ zhugs pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor lam dang / de min pa'i sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi sbyor lam gnyis/ dang po la yang / rgyun zhugs zhugs pa/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa/ de'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i sbyor lam dang gsum/ gnyis pa la yang drod rtse mo/ bzod pa chung 'bring gnyis dang bzhi'o/ /gsum pa yon tan ni/ drod rtse gnyis kyi gnas skabs su ni/ dbang po lnga thob te/ de lnga ni/ dad pa'i dbang po/ dran pa'i/ brtson 'grus kyi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi/ shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /bzod mchog gnyis kyis ni stobs lnga thob ste/ de lnga ni/ dad pa'i stobs/ dran pa'i/ brtson 'grus kyi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi/ shes rab kyi stobs dang lnga'o/ /bshes spring las/ ting 'dzin shes rab chos mchog lnga nyid de/ stobs dbang zhes bya rtse mor gyur pa'ang lags/ zhes dang / mdzod las/ sde tshan bdun ni go rim bzhin/ /las ni dang po pa dag dang / /nges 'byed yan lag rnams dang ni/ /bsgom dang mthong la rab tu byed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /yang drod kyi gnas skabs su/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me skye ba'i snga ltas yin pas drod dang / rtse mo la dge rtsa mi 'chad pa dang / bzod pa la ngan song spong ba dang / chos mchog la 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyi mchog thob pa yin te/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi/ me skye ba'i snga ltas yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / rtse mo thob pa rtsa mi 'chad/ /bzod thob ngan song yong mi ltung / /'jig rten pa 'i chos kyi mchog

/ces gsungs so/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ mthong lam la dngos su sbyor bas na sbyor ba'i lam/ nges 'byed ni mthong lam yin la de'i cha nas phan 'dogs pas na nges 'byed yan lag gam/ de dang dmigs rnam mthun par rjes su zhugs pas na nges 'byed cha mthun nam/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don/ don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs zhing / mngon bar rtogs pa la mngon du phyogs pas na don mngon par rtogs pa rnams ni rnam grangs dang bcas te sgra bshad pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa/ nyon thos kyi mthong lam yang / spang bya mthong spong gi rnam gzhag gnyen po mthong lam gyi rnam gzhag spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi dngos gnyen nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam yod pa can gyi bden pa la log par zhugs pa'i kun btags kyis rab tu phye ba'i spang bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas sdug bsngal mthong spang / kun 'byung mthong spang / 'gog pa mthong spong / lam mthong spang dang bzhi'i mtshan nyid rnams ni rim bzhin/ rang gi dngos gnyen nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam yod pa can gyi sdug bsngal bden pa la log par zhugs pa'i kun btags kyis rab tu phye ba'i spang bya'o/ /de can gyi kun 'byung bden pa la log par zhugs pa'i 'dra/ de can gyi 'gog pa la log par zhugs pa'i 'dra/ de can gyi lam gyi bden pa la log par zhugs pa'i 'dra'o/ /khams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dod khams kyi/ gzugs khams kyi/ gzugs med khams kyi mthong spang gsum las/ de re re la yang bden bzhi'i mthong spang bzhi bzhi las/ 'dod khams kyi sdug bsngal mthong spang la yang / 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom ste/ lta min lnga dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ log par lta ba/ lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba lte lta ba lnga dang bcu/

de bzhin du kun 'byung mthong spang la bcu/ 'gog pa mthong spong la bcu/ lam mthong spang la bcu ste bzhi bcur yod la/ khams gong ma gnyis la khong khro med pas/ lta ba lnga dang / lta min bzhi ste/ gzugs khams na dgu bzhi sum cu rtsa drug gzugs med khams na yang dgu bzhi sum cu rtsa drug ste khams kyi sgo nas phye na mthong spang nyon mongs brgya dang bcu gnyis/ sa yis phye na 'dod pa'i sa la bzhi bcu/ bsam gtan dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched de/ sa brgyad po re re la dgu bzhi sum cu rtsa drug rtsa drug tu phye bas gsum brgya nyer brgyad du yang 'gyur ro/ /mdzod ltar na 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang la sngar ltar lta ba lnga dang / lta minalnga ste bcu/ kun 'byung mthong spang dang 'gog pa mthong spang gnyis la/ lta min lnga dang / 'jigs lta mthar 'dzin ni gnyis ma gtogs pa lta ba phyi ma gsum gyi log zhugs med pas bdun bdun dang / lam mthong spang la tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi log zhugs yod pas brgyad dang / khams gong na khong khro med pas na/ sdug bsngal mthong spang la dgu/ kun 'byung dang 'gog pa gnyis la drug drug dang / lam mthong spang la bdun yod par 'dod de/ mdzod las/ de dag bcu dang bdun bdun brgyad/ /lta ba gsum gnyis ma gtogs pa/ /'dod na sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /mthong bas rim bzhin spong bar byed/ /bzhi ni sgom pas spang bya yin/ /khong khro ma gtogs de dag nyid/ /gzugs khams gzugs med de dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa spong byed gnyen po mthong lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ yon tan/ nges tshig dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du mthong ba'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa ngo bo'i sgo nas shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug tu yod de/

sdug bsngal chos bzod/ chos shes gnyis/ sdug bsngal rjes bzod/ rjes shes gnyis/ de bzhin du kun 'byung la bzhi/ 'gog pa la bzhi/ lam la bzhi'o/ /mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ mdzod ltar na/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang dngos su spong bar byed pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de nyan thos kyi sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de bzhin du nyan thos zhes pa kun la sbyar ro/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang las dngos su grol ba'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de sdug bsngal chos shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ khams gong gi sdug bsngal mthong spang dngos su spong bar byed pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ sdug bsngal rjes bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de las dngos su grol ba'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de sdug bsngal rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de bzhin du phyi ma'i bcu gnyis la yang sbyar ste shes par bya'o/ /'di ni dmigs rnams 'chad sla ba'i phyir/ mtshon bya de dag brjod pa yin gyi/ lugs 'di la mtshan nyid de dag nyan thos kyi mthong lam skad cig ma dang po'i mtshan nyid dang gnyis pa'i dang / gsum pa'i nas bco lnga pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ zhes pa'i bar du mthong lam sbyar/ bcu drug pa la ni bden pa mngon rtogs skad cig ma bcu drug pa'i mtshan nyid yin zhes sbyar dgos te/ mthong lam skad cig ma dang po yin na/ sdug bsngal chos bzod yin pa ma khyab te/ de'i tshogs pa na yod pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa dang / de'i thob pa dang sdug bsngal chos bzod rang dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung gzhan rnams kyang mthong lam skad cig ma dang po yin yang / sdug bsngal la chos bzod min pa'i phyir te/ shes rab min pa'i phyir ro/ /des gzhan rnams la'ang shes par mdzod cig des na shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug po ni mthong ba mngon rtogs dang / de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung rnams ni dmigs pa mngon rtogs dang /

de'i tshogs pa na yod pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa dang / thob pa rnams ni bya ba mngon rtogs zhes bya ste/ mdzod las/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa ni/ /sems kyi skad cig bcu drug go /de la skad cig bco lnga ni/ /ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam/ /zhes dang / mthong dmigs bya ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ kun btus ltar na/ sdug bsngal mthong spang dngos su spong bar byed pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de las dngos su grol ba'i rnam grol lam bden pa mngon rtogs de sdug bsngal chos shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ sdug bsngal chos shes kyi 'jug thog de ma thag tu byung zhing / chos bzod chos shes gnyis la dmigs nas/ de gnyis 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyur nges pa 'dren par byed pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de sdug bsngal rjes bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de'i de ma thag tu byung zhing de la dmigs nas/ de'i ngo bo yongs su gcod par byed pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ sdug bsngal rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ 'dis phyi ma bcu la yang rigs 'gre mdzod/ mngon rtogs rgyan ltar na/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi mi rtag pa la/ nges shes 'dren pa'i nus pa dang por thob pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de bzhin du sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi mi rtag sdug bsngal/ stong / bdag med/ kun 'byung bden pa'i steng gi rgyu/ kun 'byung / rab skye/ rkyen/ 'gog pa'i bden pa'i steng gi 'gog pa/ zhi ba/ gya nom/ nges 'byung / lam bden gyi lam/ rig pa/ sgrub pa/ nges 'byin la/ nges shes 'dren nus pa'i nus pa dang por thob pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa mngon rtogs de lam rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid yin gsung rogs mdzod/ yang lam gyi sgo nas dbye na/

bar chad med lam/ rnam grol lam/ khyad par gyi lam dang gsum la/ mngon pa las ni/ bzod pa brgyad bar chad med lam dang / shes pa brgyad rnam grol lam du 'jog ste/ mdzod las/ bzod dang shes pa go rim bzhin/ /bar chad med dang rnam grol lam/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /mngon pa gong ma las ni/ chos shes bzhi rnam grol lam dang / rjes bzod dang / rjes shes rnams ni khyad par gyi lam du bshad pa yin no/ /rgyan las ni sdug bsngal chos shes de kho na bar chad med lam dang / lhag ma bco lnga ni rnam grol lam dang khyad par gyi lam gnyis ka yin par 'dod do/ /rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na/ zhugs pa'i rgyud kyi mthong lam dang / 'bras gnas kyi rgyud kyi mthong lam gnyis/ dang po la rgyun zhugs zhugs pa/ chags bral phyir 'ong zhugs pa/ de'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i rgyud kyi mthong lam dang gsum/ de re re la yang / sdug bsngal chos bzod nas/ lam rjes bzod kyi bar bco lnga/ bco lnga yod do/ /gnyis pa rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong / 'bras gnas/ de'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi rgyud kyi mthong lam dang gsum/ de gsum po ni/ bcu drug pa lam rjes shes kho nar nges so/ /yang rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ gnas skabs nyan thos su rigs nges pa'i mthong lam dang / rigs ma nges pa'i mthong lam gnyis su yod do/ /gsum pa yon tan ni mdzod las/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad thob par gsungs kyang / 'dir byang chub yan lag bdun thob te/ de bdun ni/ dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang / dga' dang shin tu sbyang dang ting nge 'dzin/ btang snyoms 'di bdun byang chub yan lag bdun/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang mthong spangs spong ba'i nus pa dang / 'phags pa'i grangs su gtogs pa dang / don dam pa'i dge sbyong dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing /

dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag pa thob pa la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa thob bo/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag med sngar ma mthong ba gsar du mthong bas mthong ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu nyan thos kyi mthong lam bar chad med lam kyi ngos skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i rnam grol de nyan thos kyi mthong lam gyi dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye ba la bzhi/ mdzod ltar na/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal mthong spang las dngos su grol ba'i 'bras bu/ khams gong ma'i sdug bsngal mthong spang las dngos su grol ba'i 'bras bu/ de bzhin du/ 'dod pa'i kun 'byung mthong spang / khams gong ma'i kun 'byung mthong spang / 'dod pa'i 'gog pa mthong spang / khams gong ma'i 'gog pa mthong spang / 'dod pa'i lam mthong spang / khams gong ma'i lam mthong spang las dngos su grol ba'i 'bras bu ste brgyad/ de re re la yang / 'dus byas rnam grol lam dang / 'dus ma byas 'gog pa gnyis gnyis su yod do/ /kun las btus ltar na/ sdug bsngal mthong spang / kun 'byung mthong spang / 'gog pa mthong spang / lam mthong spang dang bzhi las dngos su grol ba'i 'bras bu bzhi/ de re re la yang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis gnyis su yod par bshad/ rgyan ltar na ldog pa'i sgo nas 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis/ rdzaṃs kyi sgo nas mthong lam skad cig bco lnga/ spang bya'i sgo nas rtsa ba'i dbye ba bzhi/ de re re la yang khams kyi bcu dang dgu/ de spang ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ sngar spang bya'i sgo nas ji snyed yod pa'i 'bras bu yang de snyed yod par rig par bya'o/ /bzhi pa de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ nyan thos kyi/ mthong lam rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag la dbye na ngo bo'i sgo nas shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug la gnas pa'i gang zag bcu drug

dbang po'i sgo nas skad cig ma bco lnga la gnas pa la dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis gnyis re/ bcu drug pa la ni/ dbang po rtul po la dad mos dang / dbang po rnon po la mthong thob ces bya ste/ de la skad cig bco lnga ni/ /ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam/ /dad dang chos kyi rjes 'brang ba/ /zhes dang / bcu drug pa la de 'bras gnas/ /de tshe dbang po rno rtul dag /dad pas mos dang mthong bas thob/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gang dag theg pa gsum gyi mthong lam la dbang po rtul po la mdzod ltar bar chad med lam brgyad skye zhing / dbang 'bring la kun las btus ltar bar chad med lam bzhi dang / dbang rnon la mngon rtogs rgyan ltar bar chad med lam gcig kho na skye'o/ /zhes zer ba ni ma brtags pa ste/ mdzod las bshad pa'i mthong lam pa yin na/ dbang rtul yin pas ma khyab te/ gzhung nyid la gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir dang / kun las btus las gsungs pa la yang dbang 'bring gis ma khyab pa'i phyir dang / rgyan las gsungs pa la yang / dbang rnon gyis ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /dad dang mthong thob/ ces pa'i gzhung sku khams bzang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na grub mtha'i khyad par yin gyis/ dbang po'i khyad par ni min no/ /rten gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po la rgyun zhugs zhugs pa/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa/ de'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang gsum/ de re re la yang sdug bsngal chos bzod la gnas pa nas/ lam rjes bzod la gnas pa'i bar mthong lam pa bco lnga bco lnga yod do/ /gnyis pa 'bras gnas la yang rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong 'bras gnas/ de'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas dang gsum/ de ni bcu drug pa lam rjes shes la gnas pa'i gang zag tu nges so/ /'o na rgyun zhugs gyi 'bras bu ni/

mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spangs pas/ rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la 'dod dgos la/ de lta na ni/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos shes de rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bur 'gyur te/ mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ de'i sdug bsngal chos bzod mthong spang / kun sbyor gsum dngos su spongs pa'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir te/ mthong lam bar chad med lam yin na/ sdug bsngal chos bzod yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ 'o na nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos shes pa de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas yin par thal/ de'i sdug bsngal chos shes de/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na 'grel tshung las/ rgyun zhugs zhugs par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ skyon med de/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos shes de dbu ma pa'i lugs la mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye yang / de rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bur mi 'gyur te/ grub mtha' 'og ma gnyis dang / sgo bstun pa'i tshe yang / nyan thos kyi dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu yin na/ 'bras bu bzhi po gang rung yin pas ma khyab te/ sdug bsngal chos shes de dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ dge sbyong tshul ni dri med lam/ 'bras bu 'du byas 'dus ma byas/ grol lam zad pa rnams dang bcas/ /de dag brgya bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'bras bu bzhi po gang rung yin na/ khyad chos lnga ldan gyi/ 'bras bu yin pas khyab pa 'di ni grub mtha' gang 'og thams cad la gnad du che ste/ gzhan du na kun las btus kyi lugs la/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam chos shes de rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu yin par khas len dgos pa'i phyir/ lam chos bzod mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spongs pa'i bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir te/

mthong lam bar chad med lam yin na/ chos bzod bzhi po gang rung yin pas lugs 'di la khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ kun btus nyid las/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob pa la/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i nyan thos slob pa 'bras gnas de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid du mdzod ltar na rung yang / gzhan rnams la mi rung ste/ sngar gyi skyon de so na gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang lugs ni/ bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i nyan thos gang zhig mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba de/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid yin/ zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa sgom lam la yang / spang bya sgom spang kyi rnam gzhag gnyen po sgom lam gyi rnam gzhag spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag de la gnas pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang bzhi/ dang po sgom spang la yang mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i gnyen po yod pa gang zhig mthong spang las rdzas gzhan du yod pa'i spang bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ nyan thos kyi sgom spang / rang rgyal gyi sgom spang / theg chen gyi sgom spang dang gsum las/ phyi ma gnyis ni rang rang gi thad du 'chad la/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi sgom spang bar chad med lam gyi gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i 'khor bas bsdus pa'i phung po'o/ /dbye na/ dngos su gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i sgom spang nyon mongs dang / rgyud nas gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i las nyon gyis 'phangs pa'i 'khor ba gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi dngos gnyen nyan thos kyi sgom lam bar chad med lam yod pa can gyi lhan skyes kyis rab tu phye ba'i sems rgyud rab tu ma zhi ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/

'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa ste lta min bzhi/ 'jig lta/ mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba ste/ lta ba gnyis dang drug yod la/ lta ba phyi ma gsum dang / the tshom ni mthong spang kho na yin no/ /mdzod ltar na/ 'dod chags dang / nga rgyal dang / ma rig pa dang / 'jigs lta bzhi kho na yod gyi/ khong khro ni mthong spang du 'dod do/ /bden pa'i sgo nas dbye na sdug bsngal bden pa la brten pa'i log zhugs drug de bzhin du/ kun 'byung bden pa dang / 'gog bden dang / lam bden gyi yul la brten pa drug khams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dod pa na drug bzhi nyer bzhi/ khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro med pas lnga bzhi nyi shu nyi shu/ chung ngu 'bring chen po'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyon mongs re re la yang / che 'bring chung gsum/ chen po'i chen po/ chen po'i 'bring / chen po'i chung ngu dang gsum/ 'bring la yang / 'bring gi chen po/ 'bring gi 'bring / 'bring gi chung ngu dang gsum/ chung ngu la yang chung ngu'i chen po/ chung ngu'i 'bring / chung ngu'i chung ngu dang gsum te/ dgu dgur yod do/ /de ltar phye na/ 'dod pa'i khams na drug dgu lnga bcu nga bzhi/ gzugs kyi khams na lnga dgu bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ gzugs med khams na lnga dgu bzhi bcu zhe lnga ste brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe (zhe )bzhir yang 'gyur la/ sa dgus phye na/ 'dod pa la 'dra/ bsam gtan dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched de brgyad na lnga dgu bzhi bcu zhe lnga te/ sum brgya dang drug cur yang 'gyur la/ 'dod pa dang bsdoms pas bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhir yang yod do/ /de dag kyang bden pa re rer phye na 'dod pa na drug dgu lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa bzhi ste/ nyis brgya dang bcu drug tu yod do/ /sa phyi ma brgyad pa yang / lnga dgu zhe lnga pa bzhi bzhi ste stong bzhi brgya dang bzhi cu te/

'dod pa dang sdom pas stong drug brgya nga drug tu gsungs so/ /bden pa re re'i nyon mongs pa re re nas dbye na yang de ltar du dbye'o/ /spyir sdom ste dbye na/ sa dgu na dgu dgu brgya bcu gya gcig go /gnyis pa rgyud nas gzhom bya'i sgom spang la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgom lam gyi brgyud nas gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa gang zhig sdug bsngal bden pas bsdus pa'o/ /de la dbye na/ sdug bsngal bden par gyur pa'i nyer len gyi phung po lnga dang / ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten gnyis dang bdun du yod de/ sdug bsngal bden pa de spang bya gang zhig mthong spang min pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub te/ sdug bsngal bden pa dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub te/ sdug bsngal bden pa zad par spangs pa'i theg chen mthong lam mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa spong byed sgom lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ yon tan/ sgra bshad pa dang bzhi lasadang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyun ldan du sgom pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ mnyam gzhag gi ye shes dang / rjes thob ye shes kyi sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon rtogs la nyan thos kyi zhes pa 'di nas/ rang rgyal la ma bsleb kyi bar sbyor bar shes par bya'o/ /rang gi dngos yul la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes dang / kun rdzob la mnyam par gzhag pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba dang gnyis/ dang po ni gang zag bdag med la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ spong ba'i lam/

rnam par grol ba'i lam/ khyad par gyi lam dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang gi ngo skal gyi sgom spang nyon mongs pa dngos su spongs pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ spang bya rim gyis pa'i dbang du byas pa'i spong gnyen dang / spang bya cig car ba'i dbang du byas pa'i spong gnyen gnyis/ dang po la yang mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs rnams rim gyis spong ba'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyan thos kyi spong gnyen rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ 'dod pa'i sgom spang dgu spong pa'i spong gnyen dgu/ dang po'i dgu/ gnyis pa'i dgu/ gsum pa'i dgu/ bzhi pa'i dgu/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi dgu/ rnam shes mtha' yas kyi dgu/ ci yang med pa'i dgu/ yod min med min gyi dgu ste gya gcig de re re la yang sbyor ba'i lam dang / 'jug pa bar chad med lam gnyis gnyis yod do/ gnyis pa spang bya cig car ba'i dbang du byas pa'i spong gnyen la yang / mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs pa rnams cig car spong ba'i rigs su gnas pa'i spong gnyen nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs chen po'i chen po dgu cig car du spong ba'i spong gnyen nas/ chung ngu'i chung ngu dgu cig car du spong ba'i gnyen po'i bar dgu/ de re re la yang sbyor ba'i lam dang / 'jug pa'i bar chad med lam gnyis gnyis yod do/ gnyis pa rnam grol lam la yang mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu nyan thos kyi sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i nyan thos kyi rnam grol lam rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ sngar ltar spang bya rim gyis pa'i dbang du byas pa dang / spang bya cig car ba'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/

dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis sogs ni snga ma dang 'dra/ gnyis pa cig car ba'i dbang du byas pa yang snga ma la dpag te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa khyad par gyi lam la yang mnyam gzhag dang rjes sogs du ma yod do/ /gnyis pa kun rdzob la mnyam par bzhag pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la yang mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi dngos yul kun rdzob la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ mthar gnas/ rnam par/ zil gnon/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin dang bzhir yod la/ mdzod las/ sa brgyad rnam pa gnyis 'brel dang / /gcig bsgal so zhing 'ong nas ni/ /rigs mi mthun pa gsum par 'gro/ /thod rgal gyi ni snyoms 'jug yin/ /zhes thod rgal gsungs kyi/ seng ge rnam 'gyings ni ma bshad do/ /gnyis pa rjes thob la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rjes thob kyis bsdu ba'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ mngon sum du gyur ba'i rjes thob dang / rtog par gyur ba'i rjes thob gnyis/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyi las/ dang po ni/ rjes thob mngon sum gyis bsdus pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ (mngon gsum gzhan gyi ngo bor gyur pa dang / rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi ngo bor gyur pa gnyis/ dang po la/)mngon sum tsam gyi ngo bor gyur pa dang / yid kyi mngon sum gyi ngo bor gyur pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag 'dzin lhan skyes rgyud la ldan pa'i sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi yang dag pa'i lta bas dmigs pa mngon sum rtogs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor mngon sum ni/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgom lam rjes thob kho nar nges te/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin na/ yang dag pa'i don bdag med gnyis gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa rtog pa'i ngo bor gyur pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang yul la mngon par zhen pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi mi rtag pa la mngon par zhen pa nas/ sdug bsngal/ stong pa/ bdag med/ rgyu/ kun 'byung / rab skye/ rkyen/ 'gog pa/ zhi ba/ gya nom/ nges 'byung / lam/ rig pa/ sgrub pa/ nges 'byin la/ mngon par zhen pa'i bar bcu drug tu yod do/ /ding sang nyan thos kyi sgom lam yin na/ gzhi shes yin pas khyab/ gzhi shes yin na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pas khyab par smra ba rnams la ni 'di 'dri ste/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs de sna tshogs pa yin par/ nye tshe ba dang sna tshogs nyid/ ces pa dang / 'grel chung las kyang / 'bras bu dang po la sogs pa rtogs pa tha dad pa dang / zhes dang / de'i ṭikar nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs ni 'bras bu dang po la sogs pa rtogs pa tha dad pa nyid de/ mi rtag pa la sogs par dmigs pa'i rnam pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / de dag gi don kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'grel gyi mthong sgom rtogs rigs tha dad med pa'i don la/ dpyad pa las kyang / nyan thos kyi mthong sgom gnyis la/ rtogs rigs mtha' dad med par gsungs pa'i don mnyam gzhag gi rtogs rigs dang rtogs rigs sna tshogs su gsungs pa'i don rjes thob kyi rtogs rigs la 'jog pa sogs mun khung du sgron me ston pa lta bu'i bshad pa mdzad kyang / da dung re re tsam gyi yid la ma gtogs/ mngon rlom can rnams kyis rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /yang nyan thos kyi sgom lam de la/ lam gyi sgo nas dbye na/ spong ba'i lam/ rnam par grol ba'i lam/ khyad par gyi lam dang gsum/ dang po gnyis ni/ gang zag gi bdag med la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i sgom lam kho na yin pas gong du bshad zin to/ /gsum pa khyad par gyi lam la yang / mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/

dang po ni 'phags lam snga ma las khyad par du 'phags pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gsum pa dbye na/ lam snga ma la ltos nas bzhag pa'i khyad par gyi lam/ shes bya mkhyen tshul la ltos nas bzhag pa'i khyad par gyi lam/ yon tan bsgrub tshul la ltos nas bzhag pa'i khyad par gyi lam dang gsum las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni snga ma dang 'dra/ gnyis pa dbye na/ mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis las/ de ni sgom lam skad cig ma dang po la ltos nas gnyis pa khyar par gyi lam yin pa lta bu'o/ gnyis pa la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po/ mkhas bya'i dngos po drug gang rung la mkhas pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ gnyis pa dbye na/ bden pa la mkhas pa/ phung po la mkhas pa/ khams la/ skye mched la/ rten cing 'brel 'byung la/ gnas dang gnas min pa la mkhas pa dang drug go /gsum pa la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug thob la ma nyam pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ gnyis pa dbye na/ mthar gnas/ rnam par/ zad par/ zil gnon/ smon gnas dang lnga'o/ /yang sgom lam de la gnyen po'i sgo nas dbye na/ sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po/ spong pa'i gnyen po/ rten gyi gnyen po/ thag sring ba'i gnyen po dang bzhi las/ mtshan nyid rnams ni rim bzhin rang gi ngo skal gyi sgom spang nyon mongs rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs kyis mgo mnan pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ de dngos su spong par byed pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ /(de las grol ba'i nyan thos kyi rjes kyi mngon rtogs/)de las grol ba yin pa ni gang zhig rnam grol lam min pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ gsum pa yon tan ni/ sgom spang nyon mongs spong bar byed pa dang / 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po thob par byed pa ste/ de brgyad ni/

yang dag lta dang 'tsho dang rtsol ba dang / /dran dang ting 'dzin ngag dang las mtha' dang / /yang dag rtogs nyid lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa sgra bshad ni/ gang zag bdag med rtogs zin rgyun ldan du sgom pas na sgom lam dang / bden pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rjes la rtogs pas na rjes la mngon rtogs zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu nyan thos kyi sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi sgom spang las grol ba'i rnam grol/ gnyis pa ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ 'bras bu 'dus byas 'dus ma byas gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin du/ de las dngos su grol ba'i rnam grol lam du gyur pa'i nyan thos kyi rjes la mngon rtogs dang / de las grol ba'i nyan thos sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'dus ma byas rnam byang bden pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rim gyis pa'i 'bras bu dang / cig car ba'i 'bras bu gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs dgu las grol ba'i 'bras bu dgu/ de bzhin du/ bsam gtan dang po dang / gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa'i bar gyi nyon mongs dgu dgu las grol ba'i 'bras bu dgu/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs dang po gsum las grol ba brgyad/ de'i nyon mongs dgu pa las grol ba'i lam gyi sgom lam ni med de/ srid nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi 'bras bu yin na/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu yin dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa cig car ba'i dbang du byas pa la yang / mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs rnams cig car du spong ba'i rigs su gnas pa'i rang rgyu nyan thos kyi sgom lam bar chad med lam kyi ngo skal gyi nyon mongs las grol ba'i nyan thos sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi rnam grol lam/ de la dbye na/ khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs dang po brgyad spang ba'i rnam grol lam brgyad/

dgu pa las grol ba ni med de/ dgu pa spangs pa'i 'bras bu de cig car ba'i dgra bcom gyi 'bras bur 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu/ phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po la/ spang bya rim gyis pa dang / cig car ba'i rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu gnyis/ phyi ma gnyis la chags bral sngon song gi 'bras bu dang / rim gyis pa'i 'bras bu gnyis te/ drug tu yod pa'o/ /bzhi pa de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ nyan thos sgom lam pa'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / nyan thos kyi mi slob lam ma skyes gong gi nyan thos slob pa 'phags pa'o/ gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi sgom lam rgyud la ldan pa dang / rang rgyal gyi sgom lam rgyud la ldan pa'i nyan thos sgom lam pa gnyis/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas dbye na/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas dang gsum/ dang po la gnyis las mtshan nyid ni/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam gang zhig mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas dang / cig car ba'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po la nyan thos sgom lam par gyur pa'i rgyun zhugs gang zhig khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs rnams rim gyis spong ba'i rigs su gnas pa de de'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na 'bras gnas tsam po pa dang / khyad par can gnyis te/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ de gang zhig phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu thob phyir du mi brtson pa dang brtson pa'o/ /gnyis pa cig car ba la yang / mtshan nyid ni de gang zhig khams gsum gyi sgom spang nyon mongs rnams cig car du spong ba'i rigs su gnas pa'o/ /dbye na tsam po dang / khyad par can gnyis/

mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ de gang zhig cig car ba'i dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu thob phyir du mi brtson pa dang / brtson pa'o/ /gnyis pa phyir 'ong 'bras gnas la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i khyad chos lnga ldan gyi nyan thos kyi slob pa 'bras gnas gang zhig rgyun zhugs kyi rigs su mi gnas pa'o/ /dbye na/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong dang / rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong gnyis/ de re re la yang / tsam po dang / khyad par can gnyis gnyis yod do/ /gsum pa phyir mi 'ong la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i khyad chos lnga ldan gyi nyan thos slob pa 'bras gnas/ dbye na chags bral sngon song dang / rim gyis pa gnyis/ de re re la yang / tsam po dang / khyad par can gnyis gnyis/ tsam po la yang / dad mos dang / mthong thob gnyis gnyis/ khyad par can la'ang / dbang po'i sgo nas 'dra/ byed las kyi sgo nas gzugs su nyer 'gro/ gzugs med du nyer 'gro/ mthong chos zhi/ lus mngon byed/ tshe yongs gyur gyi phyir mi 'ong lnga/ dang po la yang / bar mda' ba/ skyes mda' ba/ mngon par 'du byed pa dang bcas te mda' ba/ mngon par 'du byed med pa mda' ba/ 'phar ba/ phyed du 'phar ba/ gnas thams cad du 'pho ba dang / srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro dang brgyad/ lnga pa la 'dod par tshe yongs gyur dang / gzugs su dang / gzugs med du tshe yongs gyur dang gsum yod do/ /lnga pa nyan thos kyi mi slob lam la yang / lam dngos kyi rnam gzhag dang / de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam gyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug gi sgo nas/ 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs ma lus pa spang pa'i nyan thos kyi mkhyen pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ zad mi skye shes pa gnyis/

rten gyi sgo nas lhag bcas pa'i mkhyen pa dang / lhag med pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i nyan thos/ dbye na ngo bo'i sgo nas lhag bcas pa dang lhag med gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgra bcom dang por thob pa'i lus rten dang bcas pa'i nyan thos so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rigs kyi sgo nas bdag gsod pa'i chos can gyi dang / 'chi bar sems pa'i chos can gyi dang / rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can gyi dang / rtogs pa'i skal ba can gyi dang / gnas pa mi bskyod pa'i dang / mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang drug tu yod/ khams kyi sgo nas 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med khams pa'i dgra bcom pa dang gsum/ lhag med myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid ni dgra bcom dang por thob pa'i lus rten dang bral ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'o/ /dbang po'i sgo nas dbye na/ dus sbyor dang / dus mi sbyor gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa gang zhig dbang po rtul po'i ngo bor gyur pa dang / de gang zhig dbang po rnon po'i ngo bor gyur pa'o/ /yon tan gyi sgo nas shes rab kyi cha las rnam par grol ba dang / gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ dngos gzhi'i rnam thar ma thob par bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa las grol ba'i nyan thos/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug thob pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'o/ /mdzod ltar na gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa la nges par 'gog snyoms thob dgos te/ 'gog thob gnyis ka las rnam grol/ /shes rab kyi ni gcig shos so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/

kun las btus ltar na rnam thar nges par thob dgos so/ /de bzhi ni lhag bcas pa dang lhag med pa gnyis ka la yod par shes par bya'o/ /de la dngos smra ba rnams ni lhag med myang 'das kyi skabs su 'dus byas kyi 'jug pa rgyun chad par 'dod la/ dbu ma pa ni/ zag bcas kyi phung po rgyun chad pa la 'dod de/ lus zhig tshor ba bsil bar gyur/ /'du shes 'gags shing 'du byed zhi/ /rnam par shes pa nub gyur pa/ /de 'dra de ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /zhes dang / mar me shi bar gyur pa bzhin/ /de yi sems ni rab tu zhi/ /zhes dang / tshig gsal las/ lhag bcas pa ni rkun po bsad nas grong ma stong pa lta bu/ lhag med pa ni/ rkun po yang bsad/ grong yang stongs pa lta bu/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang rkun po'i dpes/ las nyon dang / grong gi dpes ni las nyon kyi 'bras bu zag bcas kyi phung po ste/ phung po lnga bstan pa yin pas na/ nyon mongs med kyang de dag la/ /las kyi 'bras bu mthong ba yin/ /zhes pa dang yang gnad gcig pa yin/ gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam la yang / lam bgrod tshul gyi rnam par gzhag pa dang / bgrod bya lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bse ru lta bu'i lam bgrod tshul dang / tshogs na spyod kyi lam bgrod tshul gnyis/ dang po la rang sa nas bshad pa dang / mdzod nas gsungs pa gnyis/ dang po ni bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags pa sngon du song nas/ skye ba gcig gi thogs pa phan du rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam drod tsam yang rgyud la skyed ma nus par/ skye ba phyi ma la rang rgyal gyi drod nas/ zad pa shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa thob phyir du mkhas bya'i dngos po drug la tshe 'dir mkhas par byed cing / 'chi khar smon lam rnam pa gsum 'debs pa ste/ 'di ni rang sa nas bshad pa'i lam bgrod tshul dang po'o/ /gnyis pa mdzod nas kyang 'di dang cha 'dra bar gsungs te/ bse ru bskal pa brgya yi rgyus/

zhes gsungs/ ston dang bse ru byang chub bar/ /bsam gtan mtha' rten gcig la kun/ /zhes dang / gnyis pa tshogs na spyod pa'i lam bgrod tshul la nges pa'i dang / ma nges pa'i bgrod tshul gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags pa sngon du song zhing / skye ba gcig gi thogs pa man chad du/ rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam bzod 'bring man chad rgyud la skyed cing / bzod chen bskyed ma nus par phyi ma la bzod chen nas/ zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i bar mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ tshe 'dir mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byed cing / 'chi khar smon lam gsum 'debs pa'o/ /'di ni rang sa nas bshad pa'i lam bgrod tshul gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni bskal ba brgyar tshogs bsags pa sngon du song nas/ skye ba gcig gi thogs pa man chad du/ rang rgyal gyi lam gyi sgo nas 'bras bu dang po gnyis po gang rung mngon du byas te/ skye ba phyi ma la 'bras bu phyi ma gnyis mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ tshe 'dir mkhas pa'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byed cing / 'chi khar smon lam gsum 'debs pa'i/ de gsum ni sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig der slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma ltos par rang byung gi byang chub mngon du byed par gyur cig rang gi gdul bya la lus kyi sgo nas brjod pa med par chos ston par gyur cig ces pa dang gsum mo/ /'di ni rang sa nas bshad pa'i lam bgrod tshul gsum pa'o/ /gnyis pa ma nges pa'i lam bgrod tshul la yang / kun btus nas bshad pa dang / mdzod nas bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ cig car ba'i nyan thos rgyun zhugs/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu mngon du byed mi nus par/ rang byung gi byang chub mngon du byed pa ste/ kun btus las/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa na/ rang rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/'di ni thog mar rang rgyal gyi lam du 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang rgyal gyi sgom lam nas 'jug pas gzung ba chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa mdzod nas bshad tshul la yang / so skye sngon song dang / nyan thos sngon song gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyis slob rigs las zlog nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin pas/ skye ba gcig gi thogs pa man chad du nyan thos kyi sbyor lam bzod 'bring man chad rgyud la skyed nas phyi ma la rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam bzod chen nas bzung ste/ zad mi skye shes pa'i bar mngon du byed pa'o/ /'di ni thog mar rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam nas 'jug go /gnyis pa ni skye ba gcig gi thogs pa man chad du/ /'bras bu dang po gnyis po gang rung mngon du byas nas/ tshe phyi ma la sangs rgyas dang nyan thos mi bzhugs pa'i zhing khams su 'bras bu phyi ma gnyis mngon du byed pa'o/ /'di yang thog mar rang rgyal gyi lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ sbyor lam nas 'jug pa yin gyi/ kun las btus ltar sgom lam nas 'jug pa ni ma yin no/ /de mdzod kyi lugs la nyan thos kyi bzod chen thob nas theg pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de nyan thos su 'jog pa ni sangs rgyas kyi 'khor na yod srid pa dang / nyan thos gzhan dang lhan cig tu gnas srid pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /'di yang gzhan gyis ma rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa bgrod par bya ba lam gyi rnam gzhag la yang / rang rgyal gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang rgyal gyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam dang lnga las/ dang po tshogs lam la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs gang zhig chos mngon rtogs kyis rab tu phye bo/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam chung ngu / 'bring / chen po dang gsum gyi/

mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam gang zhig dran pa nyer gzhag gi yon tan gyis rab tu phye ba dang / de gang zhig yang dag spang ba'i yon tan gyis rab tu phye ba dang / de gang zhig rdzu 'phrul gyi yon tan gyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /de re re la yang / bse ru lta bu'i tshogs lam dang / tshogs spyod kyi tshogs lam gnyis/ phyi ma la yang / nges pa'i dang / ma nges pa'i rigs gnyis gnyis su yod do/ /gnyis pa sbyor lam la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang rgyal gyi 'jug ngogs gang zhig don mngon rtogs kyi rab tu phye ba'o/ /dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi/ dang po la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam gang zhig rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / rang rgyal gyi rtse mo ma skyes gong gi ye shes so/ /dbye na chung 'bring chen po gsum/ gnyis pa rtse mo la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni rang rgyal gyi drod chen po rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / bzod pa ma skyes gong gi rang rgyal gyi don mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ sngar dang 'dra ba yin no/ /bzod pa la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam drod gang zhig drod rtse chos mchog gang rung las gzhan du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ chung ngu 'bring chen po dang gsum/ rgyu'i sgo nas rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam gyi rjes su byung ba'i dang / nyan thos kyi sbyor lam gyi rjes su byung ba'i bzod pa gnyis so/ /chos mchog la yang mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ bzod pa'i rgyun rdzogs rjes 'byung zhing / rang rgyal gyi mthong lam ma skyes gong gi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs so/ /gnyis pa dbye na gsum/ de dag thams cad la yang mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis gnyis su yod do/ /gsum pa rang rgyal gyi mthong lam la/

rang rgyal gyi mthong spang gi rnam gzhag gnyen po mthong lam gyi rnam gzhag spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang rgyal gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam kyi gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i spang bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rnam par rtog pa/ rnam byang gi rnam par rtog pa/ gzugs sogs la tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi rnam rtog rang gi rtogs pa la mchog tu rlom pa'i rnam rtog thob zin yongs su nyams pa'i rtog pa dang drug tu yod do/ /gnyis pa gnyen po mthong lam la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba/ yon tan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs gang zhig bden pa mngon rtogs kyi rab tu phye ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na ngo bo'i sgo nas/ shes bzod skad gcig ma bcu drug yul gyi sgo nas bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rang rgyal gyi mthong lam dang / gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa'i mthong lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ bse ru lta bu dang / nges pa'i rang bzhin can gyi mthong lam gnyis te/ tshogs lam gyi skabs su bzung ba chos kyi bdag med thos bsam gyis gtan la phab/ sbyor lam gyi skabs su/ don spyi'i tshul gyis sgoms pas mthong lam gyi skabs su mngon sum du mthong ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ so skye sngon song / nyan thos sngon song gi mthong lam lta bu te/ tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs su bzung ba chos kyi bdag med thos bsam gyis gtan la ma phab pa'i phyir/ de'i tshogs lam de nyan thos kyi tshogs lam yin gyis/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam min pa'i phyir/ der thos bsam gyis gtan la ma phab pas sbyor lam du don spyi'i tshul gyis ma bsgoms/ der ma bsgoms pas mthong lam du mngon sum du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ 'o na de nyan thos kyi mthong lam dang khyad par med par 'gyur ro/

/zhe na khyad par med pa min te/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa la khyad par med kyang / rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma brten par rtogs pa'i khyad par dang / theg 'bring gi mngon rtogs yin min gyi khyad par la sogs pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi mthong lam dang / rang rgyal gyi rigs can gyi rgyud kyi mthong lam gnyis gnyis yod de/ dang po ni/ nyan thos sngon song gi rang rgyal gyi rgyud kyi mthong lam dang / gnyis pa nges pa'i rang bzhin kyi tshogs spyod/ bse ru lta bu dang / so skye sngon song gi rang rgyal gyi rgyud kyi mthong lam lta bu'o/ /gsum pa yon tan ni/ nyan thos gzhan las theg 'bring gi mngon rtogs su gyur pa dang rang gi spang bya shes sgrib bzung rtog spong ba la sogs pa'i yon tan yod pa'o/ /gsum pa spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la yang / mtshan nyid dang bye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu rang rgyal gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam kyi ngo skal gyi spang bya las grol ba'i rnam grol lam/ gnyis pa dbye na/ spang bya'i sgo nas mthong spang nyan mongs spangs pa'i 'bras bu dang / mthong spang shes sgrib kyi bzung rtog spangs pa'i 'bras bu gnyis so/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas 'bras bu 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis/ de re re la yang mthong spang nyon mongs las grol ba dang / rang rgyal gyi mthong spang shes sgrib kyi bzung rtog las grol ba gnyis gnyis su yod do/ /bzhi pa de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can mthong lam pa'i mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi bden pa mngon rtogs rgyud la ldan pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg 'bring gi gang zag go /gnyis pa dbye na/ (dbang po'i sgo nas )dbang rtul dang / dbang rnon gnyis/ rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/

bse ru lta bu'i rigs can/ tshogs na spyod pa'i rigs can gnyis/ spang bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ mthong spang nyon mongs spangs pa dang / mthong spang shes sgrib kyi bzung rtog spangs pa gnyis/ yul rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa dang / bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa gnyis/ nges ma nges kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rang rgyal du nges pa dang / ma nges pa gnyis su yang yod do/ /bzhi pa rang rgyal gyi sgom lam la/ spang bya sgom spang / spong byed sgom lam/ spangs pa 'bras bu/ de la gnas pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang bzhi/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang rgyal gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i spang bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ dngos kyi spang bya dang / brgyud nas spang bya gnyis las/ dang po la sgom spang nyon mongs dang shes sgrib kyi gzung rtog gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi skabs su bstan pa dang 'dra/ gnyis pa kun nas nyon mongs bzung rtog dang po brgyad/ rnam byang gzung rtog bar pa gnyis/ maṃ rtogaṃs paṃ druṃg (rnam rtog bzhi )dang bcu bzhir yod la/ de yang kun btags rnams ni rang rgyal gyi mthong spang dang / lhan skyes rnams ni sgom spang du rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa spong byed sgom lam la yang / rang rgyal gyi sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs gang zhig rjes la mngon rtogs kyis phye ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mnyam gzhag ye shes dang / rjes thob ye shes gnyis/ yul gyi sgo nas gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa gnyis/ (rten gyi sgo nas )bse ru lta bu'i dang / tshogs na spyod pa'i sgom lam gnyis rnams su yod do/ /gsum pa spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/

dang po ni rang rgyu rang rgyal gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i rnam grol lam/ gnyis pa dbye na/ spang bya'i sgo nas sgong spang / nyon mongs las grol ba'i dang / rang rgyal gyi sgom spang shes sgrib kyi gzung rtog las grol ba gnyis/ de re re la yang 'bras bu 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas gnyis gnyis su yod/ bzhi pa de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi rjes la mngon rtogs thob pa'i theg 'bring slob pa'i gang zag go /gnyis pa dbye na/ dbang po'i sgo nas rno rtul gnyis/ zhugs gnas kyi sgo nas rgyun zhugs dang / phyir 'ong dang / phyir mi 'ong gsum yod la/ yul gyi sgo nas gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa dang / bzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa gnyis su yod cing / rigs kyi sgo nas nges pa dang ma nges pa gnyis su yod do/ /gang dag nyan thos sgom lam pa rang rgyal gyi rigs can slob pa yin na/ nyan thos yin pas ma khyab zhes zer ba ni/ kha che bye brag tu smra bas kyang byang 'phags kyi tha snyad khas mi len par/ byang chub sems dpa'i/ tshogs lam du bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par tshogs bsags nas byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod nas bzung ste zad mi skye shes pa'i bar gdan thog gcig la mngon du byas pa'i/ 'phags lam skad gcig ma gsum cu rtsa bzhi bar ma chad du skye bas/ don la de dag rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag de sangs rgyas min zhing / so skye yang min na byang 'phags las ma 'das kyang / gzhan ngor ni de lta bu'i spu ris ma zin pas tha snyad 'jog pa bzhin du/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam grod tshul lnga po gang gis bgrod kyang skye ba gcig gi thogs pa man chad du ni lam zhugs gzhir bzhag pa la nyan thos kyis khyab la/ de nas skye ba phyi ma la drod nas bzung te zad mi skye shes pa'i bar ram/
