sgom lam nas zad mi skye shes pa'i bar stan thog gcig tu mngon du byed pas don la de'i slob lam rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de/ nyan thos min zhing / mi slob pa yang min pas/ rang sangs rgyas las ma 'das kyang / gzhan ngor de lta bu'i spu ris 'byed ma thub pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas gang gi yang tha snyad mi byed pa yin no/ /gnad 'di rtogs na sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing khams su yang zhes dang / rang sangs rgyas yin na/ mi slob pa yin pas khyab pa dang / rigs can slob pa yin na/ nyan thos yin pas khyab par gsungs pa'i go ba dang don dang tha snyad kyi khyad par khas len tshul shes par 'gyur zhing gzhan du na bskal par 'bad kyang mi rtogs so/ /lnga pa mi slob lam la yang / mtshan nyid dbye ba/ de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ theg 'bring gi mthar thug gi rtogs pa'o/ /dbye na ngo bo'i sgo nas mnyam rjes gnyis/ rten gyi sgo nas bse ru lta bu'i rgyud dang / tshogs na spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lam gnyis/ byed las kyi sgo nas zad pa shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa gnyis/ yul gyi sgo nas gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa dang / ma rtogs pa gnyis rnams su yod do/ /gsum pa de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la/ theg 'bring gi gang zag gang zhig mi slob pa'i lam thob pas rab tu phye ba'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas lhag bcas pa dang / lhag med pa gnyis yod pa yin la/ dang po'i dbang du byas na/ 'dod pa'i rten can yin pas khyab kyang / gnyis pa ni/ khams gsum gang gi yang rten can min pa'o/ /yang bse ru lta bu dang / tshogs na spyod pa gnyis/ yang na gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa gnyis su yod do// ༈ //gsum pa theg chen gyi lam la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/

theg chen gyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs sam/ theg chen gyi byang chub kyi go skabs phye shul du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam/ sbyor ram/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam dang lnga las/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba/ skye tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni theg chen gyi sbyor lam ma skyes gong gi theg chen so skye'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ khyad par 'phags tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ yon tan gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu 'bring chen po dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam 'bring po ma skyes gong gi theg chen so skye'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rigs ma nges pa dang / nges pa gnyis/ dang po ni gnas skabs theg pa gzhan du 'gyur srid pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni bsam pa'i stobs kyis phyir mi ldog pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bring la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / chen po ma skyes gong gi theg chen so skye'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye ba sngar bzhin/ gsum pa theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen po la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam 'bring po rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / sbyor lam drod ma skyes gong gi theg chen so skye'i mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye ba ni sngar dang 'dra'o/ /'di ni skye ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ dbang po'i dbang du byas na/ dbang po rnon po chen po dang / dbang po rnon po 'bring dang / rtul po la chung ngur bzhag pa ste/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yi/ rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dkar bzhed/ zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par du 'phags tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ tshogs lam phal pa dang /

khyad par can gnyis/ dang po ni theg chen gyi thos bsam gtso bor gyur pa'i theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun no/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ thos pa gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs lam dang / bsam pa gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par bya/ zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang / /zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par can la yang / mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni mkhas pa'i yul lnga la mkhas pa'i bsgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i thar pa cha mthun/ de ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ zhes sogs kyis bstan no/ /mkhas pa'i yul lnga ni/ dad pa'i yul sangs rgyas sogs/ brtson 'grus kyi yul sbyin sogs drug dran pa'i yul bsam pa phun tshogs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yul chos thams cad la mtshan mar rnam par mi rtog pa/ shes bya'i yul chos thams cad do/ /'di rnam rdzogs sbyor bar gyur ba'i tshogs yin la/ yul can sbyor bzhi dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa'am/ /bye brag gi sgrub pa yang 'di nas thob pa yin yin no/ /gsum pa yon tan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i dbang du byas na/ tshogs lam chung ngu nas dran pa nyer gzhag 'bring nas/ yang dag spong ba/ chen po nas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams rim bzhin thob la/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la ni/ sha ba'i spyan dang / lha'i spyan thob pa yang yod cing / chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa yang yod par shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa skye tshul ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam gyi dang por rjes thob skye ba yin te/ chen gyi tshogs lam skad cig ma dang po de thos bsam gyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug ni mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin te/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam skad cig ma tha ma de/ theg chen gyi drod skad cig ma dang po'i dngos rgyu yin pa gang zhig drod skad cig ma dang po de/

rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me skye ba'i snga ltas yin pas de dang dmigs rnam rjes su mthun dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba/ skye tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam ma skyes gong gi theg chen gyi rnam grol gyi 'jug ngogs gang zhig theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi gnas skabs las 'das pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dang / yon tan gyi sgo nas dang / ston tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la mnyam gzhag ye shes dang / rjes thob ye shes gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi dngos yul la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med dang / bzung ba chos kyi bdag med dang / 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rnams la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni mnyam gzhag tu gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum du gyur ba'i dang / rtog pa'i ngo bor gyur ba'i mnyam gzhag dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi mnyam gzhag tu gyur pa'i gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa de/ de la yang / dgra bcom gi rtogs pa sngon song gi rgyud kyi lta bu mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa dang / slob pa 'phags pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi rgyud kyi rtogs pa lta bu mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyun ldan du sgom pa dang gnyis su yod do/ /gnyis pa ni dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam la yang /

mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag tu gyur pa'i theg chen gyi don mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rnal 'byor mngon sum du gyur pa'i dang / rtog par gyur pa'i gnyis/ dang po la bse ru lta bu'i rtogs pa sngon song gi rgyud kyi lta bu mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug gi dang / de'i rigs can slob pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi rgyud kyi lta bu mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyud ldan du sgom pa dang gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi der gyur ba'i mnyam gzhag lta bu'o/ /gsum pa 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i sbyor lam la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag gis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ drod sogs bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i sbyor lam bzhir yod la/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sbyor lam ni med de/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med de/ theg chen thun mong min pa'i rtogs bya'i bdag med yin pas/ sngar ma mthong bar mngon sum du gsar du theg chen gyi mthong lam kho nar mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjes thob la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag go /gnyis pa dbye na rtog par gyur pa dang / mngon sum gyi ngo bor gyur pa gnyis/ dang po la bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa dang / bdag med ma rtogs pa'i rtog par gyur pa'i sbyor lam gnyis/ dang po ni kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog rnam byang gzung rtog btags 'dzin rtog pa gsum po gang rung gi ngo bor gyur pa'i sbyor lam lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sbyor lam lta bu ste/

de chos can/ khyod kyis bdag med ma rtogs par thal/ khyod dang ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i bden 'dzin yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod rdzas 'dzin rtog pa ngo bor ldan pa'i sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mngon sum gyi ngo bor gyur pa la yang / rnal 'byor mngon sum gyi ngo bor gyur pa dang / mngon sum tsam gyi ngo bor gyur pa dang gnyis/ dang po la/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dman lam sngon ma song ba'i sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes lta bu ste/ de chos can/ khyod kyis bdag med ma rtogs par thal/ bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis ma rtogs pa gang zhig mngon sum du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ shes pa gang zhig rtog pa min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub te/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam thob pa min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa skye tshul gyi sgo nas/ drod rtse mo bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen po'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / theg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mo ma skyes gong gi theg chen skyes bu'i rgyud kyi mngon rtogs/ de'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing bzod pa ma skyes gong gi 'dra/ de'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing chos mchog ma skyes gong gi 'dra/ de'i rgyun rdzogs rjes su byung zhing / sdug bsngal chos bzod ma skyes gong gi theg chen skyes bu'i rgyud kyi mngon rtogs/ de re re la yang chung ngu 'bring chen po dang gsum gsum du yod do/ /gsum pa yon tan gyi sgo nas dbye na drod kyi skabs su ni/ lung ston pa'i sbyor ba/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bcu gcig rtags kyi rtse sbyor rnams thob/ rtse mo'i skabs su phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba/

phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags drug rnam 'phel gyi rtse sbyor dang gsum thob/ bzod pa'i skabs su nges par 'byung ba'i sbyor ba/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags gnyis/ brtan pa'i rtse sbyor rnams thob/ chos mchog gi skabs su bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags gcig sems kun gnas kyi rtse mor rnams thob pa'o/ /bzhi pa bstan tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ skabs dang por dngos su bstan pa nas/ lnga par dngos su bstan pa'i bar lnga las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ dmigs pa rnam pa rgyu yongs 'dzin bzhis theg dman gyi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi rtogs rigs mnyam gzhag gis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed yan lag de skabs dang por dngos bstan gyi mtshan nyid go /theg dman gyi rtogs rigs mi dmigs par bsgom pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i mnyam gzhag du gyur pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag de skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i/ dbye na nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun dang / rang rgyal gyi lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ zhen spyod mngon 'gyur ba bkag pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed yan lag de skabs gsum par bstan pa'i/ sems can la dmigs pa'i bsam sbyor dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags gang rung gi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i nges 'byed yan lag de skabs bzhi par bstan pa'i/ de la dbye na/ dro ba rnams kyis dmigs pa 'dir/ zhes pa'i skabs nas bstan pa lta bu/ sems can la dmigs pa'i sbyor lam gyi sgo nas bstan pa dang / gzugs la sogs las zlog sogs rtags/ zhes sogs kyi skabs nas bstan pa lta bu/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi sgo nas bstan pa gnyis su yod/ rtse mor thob pa'i rtags sogs bzhi po gang rung gis mtshon nas bstan pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed yan lag de skabs lnga par bstan pa'i mtshan nyid yin/

de dag thams cad la drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi bzhir yod la/ dang po gnyis su bstan pa ni/ mnyam gzhag dang bar par bstan pa la mnyam rjes gnyis ka dang / phyi ma gnyis su bstan pa ni rjes thob yin par rig par bya'o/ /gsum pa skye tshul la/ phyi'i skye tshul dang / nang gi skye tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni theg chen gyi sbyor lam gyi thog mar mnyam gzhag skye ba yin te/ theg chen gyi drod skad cig ma dang po de/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me skye ba'i sngar ltas thob ma thag pa la 'jog dgos pa gang zhig de rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang dmigs rnams rjes su mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'jug kyang mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin pa yin te/ sbyor lam chos mchog skad cig tha ma'i ye shes yin na/ mnyam gzhag yin dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa nang gi skye tshul la drod rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog dang bzhi las/ dang po drod kyi mgo mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin pa ni/ spyi'i skye tshul gyis shes la/ 'jug ni rjes thob kyis 'dzin te/ rtse mo skad cig dang po de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba g.yo ba'i rtse mo thob ma thag pa la 'jog dgos pa ni gang zhig drod skad cig ma tha ma de dang / dmigs rnam mtshungs dgos pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ rtse mo thob pa rtsa mi 'chad/ ces dang / 'grel chung las kyang / dge ba'i rtsa ba g.yo ba'i rtse mo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa rtse mo'i yang mgo rjes thob kyis 'dzin pa ni de nyid kyis grub la/ 'jug kyang mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin te/ bzod pa skad cig ma dang po de/ ngan 'gro med pa'i chos chen po la bzod pa thob ma thag pa la 'jog dgos pa gang zhig rtse mo skad cig ma tha ma de yang / de dang dmigs rnams mthun pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub te/ mdzod las/ bzod thob ngan song yongs mi stung / /zhes dang / ngan 'gro med pa'i chos chen po la bzod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pas so/

/gsum pa bzod pa'i mgo rjes thob kyis 'dzin pa ni/ de nyid kyis grub la/ 'jug kyang rjes thob kyis 'dzin te/ chos mchog skad cig ma dang po de/ 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog gi rnam byang gi stobs lnga phul du phyin pa thob ma thag pa la 'jog pa gang zhig bzod pa skad cig ma tha ma de/ de dang dmigs rnam mthun pa dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po grub te/ chos mchog lnga nyid de/ stobs dbang zhes bya rtse mor phyin pa'ang lags/ zhes dang / 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog ces dang / 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog yin pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa chos mchog gi mgo rjes thob kyis 'dzin pa yang de nyid kyis grub la/ 'jug mnyam gzhag gis 'dzin pa'ang spyi'i skye tshul gyis shes so/ /'di ni theg pa gsum char gyi dbang du byas la/ bye brag tu theg pa chen po la ni/ dmigs rnam sbyong tshul gyi sgo nas 'pho ba yin te/ drod rjes thob kyi skabs su chung 'bring chen po gsum gyi dmigs rnam gsum las/ dmigs pa ni thams cad kyang sems can la dmigs par 'dra la/ rtse mo chung ngus ni/ sems can la dmigs nas/ bdag nyid grangs bzhin du mi dge ba spong ba'i sgo nas zlog par byed cing / gzhan yang sdig pa las sdog pa la sbyor ba yin la/ drod chen po yang sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa 'di phyi gnyis kar phan pa'i bdag nyid can/ pha dang ma'i sems la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa te/ de gnyis ni gcig gi rjes la gcig 'byung ba yin no/ /bzod pa chung ngu / rtse mo chen po dang dmigs pa 'dra ba la rnam pa khyad par bden pa la dmigs la/ chos mchog kyang bzod pa chen po dang dmigs pa 'dra ba la/ rnam pa sems can smin pa dang grol bar byed pa la gnas nas gzhan gyi rten yang de ltar 'god pa'i rnam pa can du bshad pas/ nang mtshan na 'pho ba'i tshe dmigs rnam gyis bsdus pa'i tshe rjes thob kyi dmigs rnam sbyong tshul las/

na 'pho ba 'di la dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ sems can thams cad yin par bsngags/ de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs/ /rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'di dpang por yod pas the tshom med pa yin no/ /gsum pa theg chen gyi mthong lam la yang / spang bya mthong lam gyi rnam gzhag gnyen po mthong lam gyi rnam gzhag spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba khas len dang gsum las/ dang po ni rang gi dngos gnyen theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad yod pa can gyi sgrib gnyis gang rung gis bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na ngo bo dang / yul dang / khams dang / spang bya'i sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ nyes sgrib dang / shes sgrib gnyis su yod la/ nyon sgrib yin na theg chen gyi mthong spang yin pas khyab te/ byang 'phags yin na/ 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs rgyud la mi ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / nyan rang dgra bcom gyi spangs rtogs de dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i dbang du byas na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos shes nas rdzogs pa'i phyir/ dang po grub te/ rgyud blar/ 'phags pas na dang 'chi ba dang / rgas pa'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skye/ /de la de med phyir de med/ /ces dang / ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir/ /skyes sogs rnams las 'das gyur kyang / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub te/ nyid snang las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes pa dang spong ba gang yin pa de ni byang sems chen po'i mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa yin no/ /bzod pa de yang gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ shes sgrib yin na/ theg chen gyi mthong spang yin mi dgos te/ sgom lam gyi shes sgrib de theg chen gyi mthong spang min pa'i phyir/

gang dag sgom spang shes sgrib yin na/ theg chen gyi mthong spang min dgos par khas len pa ni mi 'thad de/ rang rgyal gyi sgom spang shes sgrib theg chen gyi mthong spang shes sgrib yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yul gyi sgo nas gzung rtog dang / 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni theg chen gyi mthong spang gang zhig rang yul gzung ba la dmigs nas/ longs spyad byar mngon par zhen pa'i blo'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ gzhi'i rten can gyi dang / gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog gnyis/ dang po la dgur yod de/ ma rig phung khams ming gzugs dang / /mthar chags kun byang mi shes dang / /'phags lam mi gnas dmigs pa ni/ /bdag gzhan rnam dag skyed byed do/ /gnyis pa la yang dgur yod de/ phung khams skye mched skye ba'i don/ /stong pa phar phyin mthong sgom lam/ /mi slob pa yi lam dag la/ /so sor rtog pa rnam pa dgu/ /gnyis pa 'dzin rtog la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi mthong spang gang zhig rang yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa'i blo'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / rtag 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ dang po la yang dgur yod de/ rang dbang gcig pa rgyu dang ni/ /lta ba po dang nyon mongs dang / /'dod chags bral dang mthong sgom lam/ /don byas bdag tu rtog pa dgu/ /gnyis pa la yang dgur yod de/ skyes bu'i phung khams skye mched dang / /rten 'brel rnam byang mthong sgom lam/ /khyad par lam dang mi slob lam/ /der ni rtog pa rnam pa dgu/ /de dag so so'i mtshan nyid kyang gang zhig 'dra ba la spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa dang / btags bar mngon par zhen pa sbyar ba'o/ /gsum pa khams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dod pa'i khams na dgu bzhi so drug gzugs khams na dgu bzhi so drug gzugs med khams na dgu bzhi so drug tu yod do/

/bzhi pa spang bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyan thos kyi spang bya'i rigs/ rang rgyal gyi spang bya'i rigs/ theg chen gyi spang bya'i rigs dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa gang zag gi dbang du byas pa rnams yin te/ nyan thos kyis gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i phyir dang / nyon sgrib ni gang zag gi bdag 'dzin gyi rtsa ba can yin pas na/ nyan thos la las dang nyon sgrib spangs pa'i thar pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dang po brgyad/ gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dang po bzhi/ phyi ma gsum dang bco lnga yang yin te/ rang rgyal la yang gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gzhi'i rten can gyi gzung rtog dgu pa rnam dag skyed byed spyi dang / de'i gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog gnyis te/ stong pa nyid dang phar phyin la longs spyad byar mngon par zhen pa'i blo gnyis dang / rtag 'dzin gyi rtogs pa dgu te bcu gnyis po de ni theg chen gyi spang bya'i rigs yin te/ theg chen gyi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la 'jug byar mngon par zhen pa'i 'jug pa gzung rtog dang / chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa rnams ni/ theg chen kho nas spang bar nus kyi/ theg dman gyis spang bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa khas len pa'i tshul ni/ theg chen gyi mthong spang yin na/ mthong spang yin pas ma khyab te/ nyan rang gi sgom spang thams cad theg chen gyi mthong spang yin yang / mthong spang min pa'i phyir te/ sgom spang yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sgom spang yin na/ sgom spang yin pas khyab te/ theg chen gyi sgom spang de yang spang bya gang zhig mthong spang min pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong spang yin na/ mthong spang yin pas ma khyab kyang / mthong spang yin na/ theg chen gyi mthong spang yin pas khyab te/ theg pa gsum char gyi mthong spang thams cad theg chen gyi mthong spang yin pa'i phyir/

theg chen gyi sgom spang yin na/ sgom spang yin pas khyab kyang / sgom spang yin na/ theg chen gyi sgom spang yin pas ma khyab te/ nyan rang gi spang bya thams cad theg chen gyi mthong spang yin kyang / theg chen gyi sgom spang min pa'i phyir te/ nyan rang gi spang bya thams cad mthong spang sdug bsngal chos shes thob nas spang pa'i phyir/ nyan rang dgra bcom gyi spangs pa de nas rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ gnyis pa spong byed mthong lam la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos dbyings mngon sum du mthong ba'i bden pa mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug lam gyi sgo nas bar chad lam dang / rnam grol lam dang / khyad par gyi lam dang gsum/ ston tshul gyi sgo nas skabs dang po nas lnga par bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam dang lnga las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ gnyen po tshogs sgrub kyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de skabs dang por bstan pa la/ de la dbye na/ spang bya'i sgo nas mthong spang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi'i gnyen po mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhi/ 'di phyi'i phan yon gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i/ dbye na shes bzod skad gcig ma bcu drug la mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas phan tshur rnam grangs su khas mi len pa la nges pa 'dren pa'i nus pa dang por thob pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs/ sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa sogs rigs bsgre shes par mdzod cig spros pa so gnyis dang bral ba'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de skabs gsum par bstan pa'i/ de la dbye na/ shes bzod skad gcig ma bcu drug las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ gzugs sogs rtag pa yang min/

mi rtag pa yang min pa'i don la nges pa 'dren pa'i nus pa dang por thob pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa sogs bsgre'o/ /khyad mtshan dang / phyir mi ldog gi rtags drug gang rung gi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de skabs bzhi par bstan pa'i/ dbye na spang bya'i sgo nas shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi bdag med la nges shes 'dren pa'i nus pa dang por thob pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa sogs bsgre/ /mthong spang bzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi'i gnyen por phar phyin drug gi nyams len gyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de skabs lnga par dngos bstan gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na spang bya'i sgo nas/ gnyen po mthong lam gyi rtse sbyor bzhi/ nyams len gyi sgo nas/ sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gis dbye ba drug de re re la yang drug drug te/ drug bzhi nyi shu rtsa bzhir yod do/ /gsum pa spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang rgyu theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i rnam grol lam/ gnyis pa dbye na 'bras bu 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal chos shes nas/ lam rjes shes kyi bar bco lngar yod do/ /gnyis pa ni mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden thams cad yin te/ mthong lam pa'i rgyud la sgom lam bar chad 'byung ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa de la gnas pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ theg chen mthong lam pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni sa gnyis pa ma thob pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ mthong lam rgyud la ldan pa'i mthong lam pa dang /

sgom lam rgyud la ldan pa'i mthong lam pa/ lam rgyud la mi ldan pa'i mthong lam pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni shes bzod skad cig bcu drug po gang rung rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag go /gnyis pa ni mnyam bzhag seng ge rnam 'gyings dang rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog pa dang / sa dang po'i yongs sbyongs rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag rnams so/ /gsum pa ni btags 'dzin gyi rtog pa mngon gyur ba rgyud la ldan pa'i mthong lam pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa sgom lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ spang bya sgom spang gi rnam gzhag spong byed sgom lam gyi rnam gzhag spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag de la gnas pa'i gang zag gi rnam gzhag dang bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam gyis gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i shes sgrib bo/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ rtog pa mngon gyur pa dang / bag chags gnyis/ dang po la yang mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ ma dag pa'i sgom lam bar chad med lam kyi gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i mngon par zhen pa'i blo'o/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la/ slob dpon ltar na/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog rnam byang gzung rtog rdzas 'dzin rtog pa/ btags 'dzin rtog pa dang bzhi/ 'phags pa dang rtsa ba ltar na/ sbyor ba'i yul gyi gzung rtog 'jug pa'i yul gyi gzung rtog sems can btags pa'i rtog pa dang / btags pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten pa'i rtog pa dang bzhi yod do/ /gnyis pa bag chags la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i bag chags so/ gnyis pa dbye na/ bag chags chen po/ 'bring / chung ngu dang gsum/ de re re la yang gsum gsum ste dgu dgur yod do/ /yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ gzung rtog dang po la dgu/ gnyis pa la dgu/ 'dzin rtog dang po la dgu/ gnyis pa la dgu ste sum cu so drug tu yod la/

khams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dod khams na sngar ltar dgu bzhi so drug gzugs khams na so drug gzugs med khams na so drug te/ brgya rtsa brgyad du yod cing / che 'bring gi sgo nas dbye na/ re re la yang chen po'i chen po/ chen po'i 'bring / chen po'i chung ngu dang gsum/ 'bring gi chen po/ 'bring gi 'bring / 'bring gi chung ngu dang gsum/ chung ngu'i chen po/ chung ngu'i 'bring / chung ngu'i chung ngu dang gsum gsum du yod do/ /sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /chen po la sogs dri ma yi/ /gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la/ /sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na theg chen gyi sgom spang yin na/ shes sgrib yin pas khyab te/ sgrib pa de la nyon sgrib dang / shes sgrib gnyis las/ nyon sgrib ni theg chen gyi sgom lam thob nas spangs tshar ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de theg chen gyi mthong spang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrib pa gnyis po de rang ldog nas sgom spang du khas len pa yin yang / khyab mtha' ni mi 'cha' te/ mthong spang nyon sgrib dang / mthong spang shes sgrib yod pa'i phyir dang / de dag sgom spang min pa'i phyir/ des na mthong spang dang mthong spang sgom spang 'gal yang / theg chen gyi mthong spang dang / sgom spang gnyis mi 'gal zhing rang ldog ni mthong spang du khas len pa yin te/ mthong lam bar chad med lam gyis gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa'i spang bya yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam gyis gzhom bya'i rigs su gnas pa yin pa'i phyir te/ kho'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po grub te/ theg chen gyi sgom lam thob nas spangs tshar ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub te/ nyan rang gis shes sgrib cung zad kyang spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na 'di lta bu'i khas len tshul ni shin tu gal che bas zhib mo'i sgo nas bshad pa'o/

/gnyis pa spong byed theg chen gyi sgom lam la yang / mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs zin rgyun ldan du sgom pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas/ zag bcas sgom lam dang / zag med sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rjes thob ye shes dang / mnyam gzhag ye shes gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yod/ gnyis pa dbye na/ mos pa sgom lam/ bsngo ba sgom lam/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su nges pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs so/ gnyis pa dbye na/ rang don mos pa/ gnyis don mos pa/ gzhan don mos pa dang gsum las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin yum rang don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su nges pa dang / yum gnyis don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su nges pa'i dang / yum gzhan don phun tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su nges pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs dang bcas pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yod/ de re re la yang / chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum/ de re re la yang / chung ngu'i chung ngu / chung ngu'i 'bring / chung ngu'i chen po dang gsum/ 'bring gi chung ngu / 'bring gi 'bring / 'bring gi chen po dang gsum/ chen po'i chung ngu / chen po'i 'bring / chen po'i chen po dang gsum te/ nyer bdun mas rim bzhin/ sa gnyis pa'i mos pa nas/ sa bcu pa'i mos pa'i bar rnams yin no/ /mos pa sgom lam yin na/ 'di dgu po gang rung yin pas ma khyab te/ sa dang po'i mos pa rnams/

mos pa sgom lam yin yang / dgu po gang yang min pa'i phyir ro/ /(gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po/ dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur yongs su sgyur bar byed pa'i sogs 'dra/ gnyis pa dbye ba sngar bzhin dgu'o/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po rang gzhan gyi dge ba la dga' ba sgom par byed pa'i sogs 'dra/ gnyis pa dbye ba sngar bzhin dgu'o/)gnyis pa rnam gzhag sgom lam la yang / mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bcas pa'i mnyam gzhag gis bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam 'gyings/ thod rgal/ zad par/ zil mnan/ rnam thar/ mthar gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams su yod do/ /de dag zag bcas sgom lam yin te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rnam rtog dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang yul chos dbyings gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ sgrub pa sgom lam/ rnam dag sgom lam/ khyad par gyi lam dang gsum las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni rang gi ngo skal gyi sgom spang shes sgrib dngos su spong ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye na/ sa gnyis pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam nas sa bcu pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam gyi bar dgu/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ theg chen gyi sgom spang shes sgrib chen po'i chen po'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i dang / chen po'i 'bring dang / chen po'i chung ngu dang / 'bring gi chen po dang / 'bring gi 'bring dang / 'bring gi chung ngu dang / chung ngu'i chen po dang / chung ngu'i 'bring dang / chung ngu'i chung ngu'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ de re re la yang /

sbyor ba'i lam dang / 'jug pa bar chad med lam gnyis gnyis su yod par rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rnam dag sgom lam la/ dbye ba dang mtshan nyid gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ gnyis pa dbye ba la sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam nas/ sa dgu pa'i rnam grol lam gyi bar brgyad du yod la/ sa bcu pa'i rnam grol lam ni med de/ sa bcu pa'i rnam grol lam yod na/ de sgom spang shes sgrib chung ngu'i chung ngu las rnam par grol ba'i lam du khas len dgos la/ de ltar na de rnam dag shin tu ba yin la/ de sgom spang shes sgrib chung ngu'i chung ngu las rnam par grol ba'i rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ni khyed rang gi drung nas zhal gyi bzhes pa yin te/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes sogs kyi gzhung gis bstan to/ /'dod na ni sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag yin par thal lo/ gsum pa khyad par gyi lam du gyur ba'i zag med sgom lam la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos dbyings gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul gyi rtogs pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs gang zhig rnam grol lam dang / spong ba'i lam las don gzhan du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ sa gnyis pa'i khyad par lam nas bzung te/ sa bcu pa'i khyad par gyi bar dgu/ gang dag zag med sgom lam yin na/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gang rung yin pas khyab par smra ba ni/ gzhung gis bstan tshul la 'khrul pa yin te/ de ltar na zag bcas sgom lam yin na/ mos sngo rjes su yi rang dang gsum po gang rung yin pas khyab par thal/ zag med sgom lam yin na/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gang rung yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam yin na/ zag med sgom lam yin pas khyab te/

theg chen gyi sgom lam yin na/ zag bcas sgom lam dang / zag med sgom lam gang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sa brgyad pa'i rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par/ yang dag mtha' mngon du byas pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes de/ zag bcas sgom lam min te/ chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom min te/ spong ba gnyen po min pa'i phyir/ rnam dag sgom min te/ rnam grol lam min pa'i phyir ro/ /des na zag med sgom yin te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rnam rtog dang mi ldan pa'i theg chen gyi sgom yin pa'i phyir te/ chos nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i sa brgyad pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhung las dngos su zag bcas sgom lam la mos bsngo rjes su yi rang gsum dang / zag med sgom lam la sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis su gsungs kyang / de dang des ma khyab pa ni gnad kyi don yin pas/ phan thogs par gyur cig ston tshul gyis sgo nas dbye na/ skabs dang po dang gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa rnams su bstan pa'i sgom lam rnams yod pa las/ mtshan nyid ni rim bzhin/ gnyen po tshogs sgrub kyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs skabs dang por bstan pa'i/ gnyis pa dbye na/ sa gnyis pa'i gnyen po tshogs sgrub nas sa bcu pa'i gnyen po tshogs sgrub kyi bar dgu yod do/ /theg chen gyi rtogs rigs kyi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs gnyis par bstan pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na/ mos bsngo rjes su yi rang dang / sgrub pa sgom lam/ rnam dag sgom lam dang lngar yod do/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang sbyor ba phyi ma gsum po gang rung gi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i 'dra/ bzhi par bstan pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na rjes thob chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs dgu dang sbyor ba phyi ma gsum du yod do/

/sgom lam rtse sbyor dang / bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gang rung gi ldog pa nas bstan pa'i lnga bar 'dra/ dbye na seng ge rnam 'gyings/ thod rgal/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang gsum/ sa'i sgo nas dbye na/ sa bcur yod de/ sa bcu rnams la sgom pa'i lam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa spangs pa 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam kyi ngo skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i rnam grol lam/ dbye na 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / dang po ni rnam grol lam dang / gnyis pa ni so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa yin no/ /bzhi pa de la gnas pa gang zag gi rnam gzhag la/ theg chen sgom lam pa'i mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis las/ sa gnyis pa thob pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa de/ de'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa dbye na/ lam rgyud la yod pa'i sgom lam pa dang / med pa'i sgom lam pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi byang 'phags dang / sa dang po drug rgyud la yod pa'i byang 'phags rnams yin te/ sa brgyad pa thob nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dbang sgyur ba thob pas/ lam rgyud la mi ldan ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /sa bdun pa man chad du sgom spang rtog pa mngon gyur du ldan pa yang srid pas/ lam rgyud la yod med gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtog pa mngon gyur ba rgyud la ldan bzhin pa'i sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi byang 'phags rnams yin no/ /sgom lam rgyud la yod na/ sgom lam pa yin pas ma khyab te/ sa dang po'i rjes thob rgyud la yod pa'i mthong lam pa de/ sgom lam rgyud la yod kyang sgom lam pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /sgom lam rgyud la med na/ sgom lam pa min pas kyang ma khyab te/ rtog pa mngon gyur ba rgyud la ldan pa'i sa gnyis pa'i byang sems 'phags pa de/ sgom lam rgyud la med kyang / sgom lam pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/gang dag dang po'i rjes thob ye shes de/ mthong sgom gang yin min te/ dang po min pa gang zhig phyi ma min pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste mnyam bzhag min pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa min te/ sgom lam chung 'bring chen po dgu po gang yang min pa'i phyir/ rim bzhin du/ chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgu ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu'i bar gyi sgom lam yin pas na/ 'di ni sa dang po'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ tshogs sbyor gang rung min pa'i so skye'i lam yod par thal/ mthong sgom gang rung min pa'i slob pa 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi lam yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang sa dang po'i rjes thob ye shes la gnas pa de/ rgyal sras min par thal/ de byang sems tshogs sbyor ba dang mthong sgom pa gang rung min pa'i phyir/ rtags grub te/ de'i rgyud kyi lam de slob lam bzhi po gang rung min pa'i phyir// ༈ //lnga pa theg chen gyi mi slob lam la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis las/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug gi ye shes de mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na rten gyi sgo nas/ longs sku dang sprul sku'i rgyud kyi ye shes gnyis/ bstan tshul gyi sgo nas/ rgyu 'bras gtso bo mkhyen pa dang / rnam rtags mtshan mas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis su yod do/ /gsum pa des grub pa'i 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spangs pa dang ye shes phun tshogs thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ ngo bo nyid sku/ longs spyod rdzogs sku/ sprul sku dang gsum las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba/ yon tan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa dang / spangs bya blo bur gyi dri ma rnam par dag pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan dang / mkhyen rtse nus pa'i yon tan dbyer med rang bzhin gyi sku'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/

rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i ngo bo nyid sku dang / glo bur gyis dag pa'i ngo bo nyid sku gnyis so/ /gsum pa yon tan ni/ zag med kyi ye shes te/ de la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang ma 'brel ba'i ye shes so/ /dbye na/ sde tshan nyer cig tu yod de/ byang phyogs so bdun nas/ rnam mkhyen gyi bar nyer gcig las/ dang po byang phyogs so bdun ni/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa de/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i byang phyogs so bdun gyi mtshan nyid yin la/ spyir ni sems can la yang yod par rig par bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshad med bzhi ni/ byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms/ zhes so/ /gsum pa rnam par brgyad ni/ gzugs can gzugs dang gzugs med gzugs/ khyad par sdug pa'i rnam par thar/ gzugs med bzhi dang 'gog pa brgyad zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa mthar gnas dgu ni/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu/ zhes pa'o/ /lnga pa zad par bcu ni/ sa chu me rlung sngo ser dang / dkar dmar nam mkha' rnam shes bcu/ zhes pa'o/ /drug pa zil gnon brgyad ni/ gzugs can chung ngu chen po dang / /gzugs med chung ngu chen po dang / /sngo ser dmar dkar rnam pa brgyad/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ gdul bya'i nyon mongs pa drung nas 'byin pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes so/ /brgyad pa smon gnas mkhyen pa brgyad ni/ khyad par bzhi ldan gyi ye shes mthar thug pa'o/ /dgu pa mngon shes drug ni/ rdzu 'phrul rna ba sngon gnas dran/ /gzhan sems shes dang lha'i mig /zag pa zad pa rnam drug go /bcu pa so so yang dag par rig pa ni/ tshig don spobs pa chos rig bzhi/ /zhes so/ /bcu gcig pa yongs su dag pa bzhi ni/ rten dmigs thugs dang ye shes bzhi/ zhes so/ bcu gnyis pa dbang bcu ni/ tshe dang sems dang yo byad dang /

/las dang skye ba mos pa dang / /smon lam rdzu 'phrul ye shes chos/ /'di dag thub pa'i dbang bcur bzhed/ /zhes pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa stobs bcu ni/ gnas las khams mos dbang po dang / /kun rtogs bzod dang (lam dang kun nyon )sngon gyi gnas/ /'chi 'pho zag pa zad mkhyen pa/ /'di dag thub pa'i stobs bcu'o/ /zhes so/ /bcu bzhi pa mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni/ rang don spangs rtogs dam bca' dang / /gzhan don spang lam dam bca' bzhi/ /zhes so/ /bco lnga pa bsrung ba med pa bzhi ni/ sku gsung thugs ni dag pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bcu drug pa dran pa/ nyer gzhag gsum ni/ chos nyan dga' dang mi nyan la/ /mi dga' gnyis 'dzin med pa gsum/ /zhes so/ /bcu bdun pa snyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid ni/ 'jig rten la dus drug tu gzigs pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /bco brgyad pa bag chags yang dag par bcom pa ni/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa las grol ba'o/ /bcu dgu pa thugs rje chen po ni/ lhag par gzhan gyi don byed pa'o/ /nyi shu pa ma 'dres bco brgyad ni/ sku la 'phrul dang gsung ca co thugs mnyam par ma bzhag dang / tha dad 'du shes dran nyams dang / /so sor ma brtags btang snyoms ni/ /mi mnga' spyod pa ma 'dres drug /'dun brtson dran ting shes rab dang / /rnam grol nyams pa mi mnga' ba/ /rtogs pa ma 'dres drug yin te/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar la/ /ma chags ma thogs ye shes gsum/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las ni/ /ye shes sngon 'gro de rjes 'brang / /zhes so/ /rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid ni/ chos thams cad ma lus par mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug gi ye shes so/ /gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs sku la yang / mtshan nyid dbye ba yon tan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi mthar thug gi gzugs sku'o/ /nges pa lnga ni/ gnas nges pa 'og min kho na/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs bar/ ngo bo nges pa mtshan dang ye shes kyi brgyan pa/

'khor nges pa sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang sems/ chos nges pa theg pa chen po'i chos gsung pa'o/ /gnyis pa da bye na/ phyogs bcu'i long sku bcur yod do/ /gsum pa yon tan ni/ mtshan dang / dpe byad dang / gsung dbyangs gsum las/ dang po mtshan la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni dpe byad kyi rgyu brgya las byung ba'i skyes bu chen por mtshon par byed pa'i 'phags pa'i yon tan no/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ zhabs dang phyag 'khor los mtshan pa la sogs pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa dpe byed la yang mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad 'grub pa'i bsod nams brgya'i rgyu las byung ba'i skyes bu chen po mdzes par byed pa'i brgyan no/ /dbye na thub pa'i sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu la sogs pa brgyad bcu'o/ /gsum pa gsung dbyangs la yang / mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbu'i gtsug tor 'grub pa'i bsod nams 'bum phrag brgya 'gyur las byung ba'i ngag gi yon tan no/ /gnyis pa dbye na gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yod do/ /sdom ni/ gnyen dang 'jam dang yid 'ong yid du 'thad/ /dag dang dri med rab gsal snyan zhing 'jam/ /mnyen pos mi tshugs bsnyan dang ral ba dang / /mi tshub mi rlang rab dul rna bar snyan/ /lus tshim sems tshim snying dga' dga' bde skyed/ /gdung med kun shes rig bya rnam par gsal/ /dga' byed mngon dga' spong shes rnam par rig /rigs 'grel skyon med seng ge glang po'i sgra/ /'brug dang klu dbang dri za ka la bhing / /tshang dang shang shang ti'u sgra dbyangs dang / /lha dbang skad dbyangs ltar snyan rnga'i sgra/ /ma khengs mi dma' rjes bzhugs gzur chag med/ /ma tshang mi gzhum mi zhen rab tu dga'/ /khyab dang tha ba med dang rgyun chags rjid/ /rdzogs byed tshim byed ma dmad mi 'gyur ba'i/ /ma brtags kun tu grags dang rnams mchog ldan/

/zhes so/ /'di ni 'phags grol gyi nyir snang dang / dbyig gnyen gyi mdo sde brgyan las 'byung ba bzhin/ bkod pa yin la/ gzhung lugs la la nas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhir bshad pa yang yod do/ /'di dag gi rgyu la spyir gzugs sku gnyis ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / chos sku ni ye shes kyi tshogs las byung ba yin la/ de'i dang po ni 'jig rten dang / nyan thos kyi/ rang rgyal gyi bsod nams ji snyed pa bcur bsgres pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig 'grub/ de thams cad 'grub pa'i bsod nams brgyar bsgyur bas/ dpe byad gcig 'grub/ de thams cad 'grub pa'i bsod nams brgyar bsgyur bas mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis 'grub/ de 'grub pa'i bsod nams stong du bsgyur bas/ mdzod spu 'grub/ mdzod spu 'grub pa'i bsod nams stong phrag brgya yis dbu'i gtsug tor 'grub/ gtsug tor 'grub pa'i bsod nams bye ba 'bum phrag bsgres pas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu 'byung ba yin te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'grub pa ste/ /chos kyi sku de mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/ /zhes dang / bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab las/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas mtshan 'byung ba/ /theg pa chen po'i gdung can la/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin gson/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi kun nas byung / /slob dang mi slob las byung ba/ /'jig rten ma lus bsod nams kun/ /'jig rten bzhin du dpag med gang / /de tsam bcu ru sgres pa yis/ /ba spu'i bu ga gcig 'grub te/ /sangs rgyas ba spu'i bu ga ni/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /bskyed pa yi ni bsod nams gang / /de dag brgyar ni bsgyur ba yis/ /dpe byed bzang po gcig tu bzhed/ /bsod nams de snyed de snyed kyi/ /rgyal po dpe byad bzang po ni/ /gcig mthar phyin che de lta bu/

/brgyad bcu'i bar du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dpe byed bzang po brgyad bcu dag /'grub pa'i bsod nams tshogs gang yin/ /de dag brgyar ni bsgyur ba yis/ /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gcig go /mtshan ni sum cu 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /bsod nams rgya chen gang yin pa/ /de dag stong du bsgyur ba yis/ /zla ba gnyis 'dra'i mdzod pu'o/ /mdzod spu yi ni bsod nams dag /stong phrag brgyar ni sdom pa yis/ /spyi gtsug mchog ni mi snang ba/ /skyob pa'i gtsug tor skyed par byed/ /gtsug tor bsod nams bye ba dag /'bum phrag brgyar ni bsgres pa yis/ /grangs ni brgya chen bcu po dag /sangs rgyas gsung gi sgra dbyangs ni/ /yan lag drug cu skyed pa'i mchog /ces gsungs so/ /'o na sangs rgya ba'i skabs mi srid par 'gyur te/ rgyu 'grub pa'i skabs mi srid pa'i phyir zer na rgyu 'grub pa mi srid pa yang min la/ rgyu dka' ba yang min te/ dper na nam mkha' dang 'byung bzhi mtha' yas pa bzhin du/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can mtha' yas/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje mtha' yas/ des sgrub pa'i bsod nams mtha' yas skad cig re la 'byung zhing / dus kyang rtag pa'i phyir te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bsod nams ni/ 'di la sgyid lug mi bya'o/ /phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' dang / /'byung bzhi mtha' yas pa bzhin du/ sdug bsngal sems can mtha' yas 'dod/ /sems can mtha' yas de dag ni/ /byang chub sems dpas skad cig la/ /sdug bsngal dag las drangs byas te/ /sangs rgyas nyid la 'god par nges/ /de ltar brtan par gnas de ni/ /mi nyal ba'am nyal yang rung / /yang dag blangs pa nas bzung ste/ /bag med gyur kyang sems can rnams/ /mtha' yas phyir ni sems can bzhin/ /bsod nams mtha' yas rtags sogs 'byung / /zhes dang / gang du sems can med gyur na/ /tshad med skad cig re re la/ /sogs pas byang chub thob bya'i phyir/

/zhum pa dang du blangs mi bla/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa sprul sku la yang mtshan nyid dang dbye ba/ yon tan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ longs sku la brten nas gang 'dul gyi skur ston pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i gzugs sku'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ mchog gi sprul sku/ bzo sprul sku/ skye ba sprul sku gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni sprul sku gang zhig graṃgs cheṃn gyi sangs rgyas kyis rab tu phye'o/ /kha gcig mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston par mdzad pa zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ bde ba can gyi sangs rgyas 'dod dpag med mchog gi sprul sku yin yang / mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni bcom ldan 'das dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i phyir du/ pi waṃ bzhes pa zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar po lta bu'o/ /gsum pa yon tan 'phrin las la yang 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ kha gcig chos skus bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan zhes pa ni mi 'thad de/ ngo bo nyid skus ma nges pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos skus bdag rkyen byas pa la brten nas byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi las so/ /gnyis pa dbye na/ rten gyi sgo nas/ bya ba yul la yod pa dang / /byed pa po la yod pa gnyis/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas 'phrin las nyer bdun du yod de/ lam gyi rten la 'god pa ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal zhi ba la 'god pa dang / lam la 'god pa la tshogs sbyor mthong sgom lam la 'god pa lnga/ tshogs lam la 'god pa la sbyor ba bsdu dngos bzhi la 'god pa dang / blta ba blang dor rtogs pa la 'god pa dang / spyod pa la gzhan don gyi spyod pa byams sogs kyi bdag nyid la 'god pa dang / rang don gyi spyod pa phar phyin drug goms pa la 'god pa dang / gnyis don gyi spyod pa sangs rgyas kyi lam dge ba bcu la 'god pa dang lnga/

sbyong lam la 'god pa la/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi stong par goms pa la 'god pa dang / mthong lam la 'god pa la/ dang por sbyin pa'i phar phyin la 'god pa dang / bsgom lam la 'god pa la/ sa gnyis pa nas lnga pa'i bar la tshul khrims kyi phar phyin nas bsam gtan gyi phar phyin gyi bar la 'god pa dang / sa drug par sher phyin la brten nas chos thams cad dmigs su med par rtogs pa la 'god pa dang / sa bdun par thabs kyi phar phyin gyis sgrib pa spang rung sogs su smin par byed pa la 'god pa dang / sa brgyad par stobs kyi phar phyin gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i byang sems kyi lam dang / chos thams cad la mngon zhen spangs pa la 'god pa gnyis dang / sa dgu par smon lam gyis gzugs skur byang chub thob pa la 'god pa dang / sa bcu thob ma thag par ye shes kyi phar phyin gyis 'od zer gyi dbang bskur la 'god pa dang / skye ba gcig gis thogs par rdzogs pa'i byang chub so sor nges pa mdzad pa dang / sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas mchod pa'i don du/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du nyer bar 'gro ba la 'god pa dang gsum dang / srid pa mtha' ma par byang chub kyi rgyu'i yan lag la 'god pa dang / las 'bras kyi 'brel pa chud mi za ba la 'god pa ste/ nus pa la 'god pa gnyis dang / phyin ci log thams cad spangs pa la 'god pa dang / phyin ci log gi sa bon med par spangs pa'i ye shes la 'god pa ste/ spangs pa la 'god pa gnyis dang / ji lta ba rtogs pa dang / ji snyed pa rtogs pa gnyis te/ rtogs pa la 'god pa gnyis dang / byang sems dang sangs rgyas kyi rnam byang gi rgyu tshogs la 'god pa te/ rgyu tshogs dag pa la 'god pa gnyis dang / lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa ni/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa te/ de ltar na sprul sku'i yon tan du sbyar yang / chos sku'i 'phrin las nyer bdun yin no/ /des na thun mong ma yin pa'i lam dang sa'i dbye ba/

mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang / de dag gi spang bya mi mthun phyogs gzhung so so las 'byung ba ma 'dres pa dang / bgrod tshul dang / skye ba dang skye ba'i rim pa blo la nges par byas nas/ sa dang lam bde blag tu dgrod de sku gsum ma thob kyi bar dang / thob nas kyang 'phrin las dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas sems can la phan bde'i 'bras bu rgya cher bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di smras pa/ sngon sbyangs blo gros dman pa min pa ldan pa dang / /tshe 'dir gzhung mang brtson pa'i stobs kyi sbyangs pa dang / /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i lcags kyu mchog gis bzung ba'i phyir/ /gang zhig smras 'di smra ba gzhan dang thun mong min/ /'ga' zhig phrag dog lag pas blo mig bkab/ /la la 'khor mang longs spyod dregs pas snyems/ /gzhan dag chen po'i nga rgyal ri yis ngaṃl/ /phal cher legs bshad mchog 'di spang du dogs/ /de slad grogs dag dpyod pa'i blo yod rnams/ /tshad ldan gzhung dang 'gal ba'i tshogs 'dug na/ /dpyad pa'i sgo nas lung rigs rnams dag gis/ /byi dor byas la bdag ni mi 'dod med/ /don med khong khro'i me sbar dge ba sreg /phrag dog rlangs pa'i tshub ma cher ngal zhing / /srang kha'i dud sprin thibs pa de dag gis/ /legs bshad siṃl ba'i gdung sel ga la bzod/ /'di brtsam dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /skyon med dge ba'i bshes la rab bsten nas/ /'jug pa bde ba'i lam la rab zhugs te/ /sku gsum mdzad pa'i dpal gyis rol bar shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /tshad ldan gzhung gi dgongs pa smra byed cing / /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi bstan pa la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sgo nas 'dzin par shog /bdag la dmigs nas g.yo sgyu rab brtsom zhing / /chags sdang kuṃn mo'i ngag mda' 'phen byed pa'i/ /bshes gnyen de dag 'di brtsams dge ba'i mthus/ /rang bzhin ngan pa de las grol gyur cig /sa dang lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa dgongs pa gsal ba'i nyi 'od ces bya ba 'di ni/
